Line in the OCR models card naming the folder the files are saved in. Takes the folder path.
Line in the OCR models card saying whose models these are. Takes the address of the project page, shown as plain text.
strings.en: The models are made by the ocrs project: {project}

strings.context: Button in the OCR models card that starts the download. Verb.
Line in the OCR models card while the files are being downloaded.

Line under the progress bar of the text recognition card while the files are downloaded. Takes the megabytes received, the megabytes in all (plain numbers, 1 MB = 1,000,000 bytes) and the percent done.
State shown in the text recognition card when the model files are already in place. One word, shown in the success color.
Sentence in the text recognition card after the models were downloaded and checked, above its Done button.
strings.en: The text recognition models are installed. ncrs now reads scans and images too.
strings.de: Die Texterkennungsmodelle sind installiert. ncrs liest jetzt auch Scans und Bilder.

strings.context: Error in the OCR models card when the download failed or a file did not pass the check. Takes the technical detail, which stays untranslated. A file that failed is never put in place.
Detail of a failed model download in the OCR and AI model cards when the server answers with an unexpected HTTP status. Takes the status number.
Detail of a failed model download in the OCR and AI model cards when the server does not answer within the time limit.
strings.en: The server did not answer in time
strings.de: Der Server hat nicht rechtzeitig geantwortet

strings.context: Detail of a failed model download in the OCR and AI model cards when the server forwards the request too many times.
strings.en: The server forwarded the request too often
strings.de: Der Server hat zu oft weitergeleitet

strings.context: Detail of a failed model download in the OCR and AI model cards when the file is larger than the expected size.
strings.en: The file is larger than expected
strings.de: Die Datei ist größer als erwartet

strings.context: Detail of a failed model download in the OCR and AI model cards when the request was sent on to a host that is not an allowed source. Takes the host name.
Detail of a failed model download in the OCR and AI model cards when the server sends an answer the app cannot use.
strings.en: The server sent an unexpected answer

strings.context: Detail of a failed model download in the OCR and AI model cards when no connection to the server could be made. Takes the technical reason, which stays untranslated.
Detail of a failed model download in the OCR and AI model cards when the secure connection could not be set up. Takes the technical reason, which stays untranslated.
Error in the OCR models card when there is no data folder to save the models in.
strings.en: There is no data folder to save the models in.
strings.de: Es gibt keinen Datenordner, in dem die Modelle gespeichert werden könnten.

strings.context: Condition of a suggested rule in its list row when the document has to contain a word or phrase. Takes the text.
Button in the rule suggestions view: turns the selected suggestion, as suggested, into a confirmed rule that Hermes uses from then on. Also the button of the rule form that confirms a suggestion.
Status bar message after Hermes filed new files of a source by itself, because filing continuously is on for it. {count} is the number of files, {folder} the name of the source.

Entry of the command palette that runs the key action download_ai_model, which opens the card asking whether to download the AI model that reads documents the rules could not read. The plain name of what the action does, as short as a menu entry; it has no key. The ellipsis says a card with a question follows.

Theme name of the key action download_ai_model, shown dimmed after its plain name action.download_ai_model in the command palette, and matched when typing. A playful name (in Futurama, heads are kept alive in jars); the plain name beside it says what the action does.
Title of the card that asks before the AI model is downloaded.

Explanation at the top of the card for the download of the AI model. Some documents cannot be read by the rules alone; a small language model reads them. The model runs on this machine only and no document is sent anywhere. It is not part of ncrs and is downloaded only after the user presses the download button; an interrupted download continues where it stopped.
strings.en: Documents the rules cannot read are handed to a small AI model. It runs on this machine only; no document leaves it. The model is one file that is not part of ncrs. Nothing is sent until you press the button. An interrupted download continues where it stopped, and the file is checked against its size and checksum before it is used.
strings.de: Dokumente, die die Regeln nicht lesen können, übernimmt ein kleines KI-Modell. Es läuft nur auf diesem Rechner; kein Dokument verlässt ihn. Das Modell ist eine einzelne Datei, die nicht zu ncrs gehört. Es wird nichts gesendet, bevor du auf die Schaltfläche drückst. Ein unterbrochener Download wird dort fortgesetzt, wo er aufgehört hat, und die Datei wird vor der Nutzung gegen Größe und Prüfsumme geprüft.

strings.context: Line in the AI model card naming the server the file is downloaded from. Takes the host name.
Line in the AI model card naming the model file and its size. Takes the file name and the size with its unit, for example 2741 MB.
Line in the AI model card under the model file: its SHA-256 checksum, which the download must match. Takes the checksum as 64 hexadecimal characters.
Line in the AI model card naming the license of the model. Takes the license name, which is not translated.
Line in the AI model card saying whose model this is. Takes the address of the model page, shown as plain text.
strings.en: The model is Qwen3.5 4B by the Qwen team: {project}
strings.de: Das Modell ist Qwen3.5 4B des Qwen-Teams: {project}

strings.context: Line in the AI model card naming the folder the file is saved in. Takes the folder path.
Button in the AI model card that starts the download. Verb.
Button in the AI model card that starts the download again after it was stopped or broke off. The file continues where it stopped. Verb.
Button in the AI model card that stops the running download. What was downloaded so far is kept. Verb.
Line in the AI model card while the file is being downloaded.
Line in the AI model card after Stop was pressed, until the download has noticed.
Line in the AI model card after the user stopped the download. Not an error: the part that was downloaded is kept.
strings.en: Paused. The download continues where it stopped.
strings.de: Angehalten. Der Download wird dort fortgesetzt, wo er aufgehört hat.

strings.context: Line under the progress bar of the AI model card while the file is downloaded. Takes the megabytes received, the megabytes in all (both plain numbers, 1 MB = 1,000,000 bytes) and the percent done as a number.
State shown in the AI model card when the model file is already in place. One word, shown in the success color.
Sentence in the AI model card after the download ended while the AI switch is being written to the config.
strings.en: The AI model is installed. Turning the AI on …
strings.de: Das KI-Modell ist installiert. Die KI wird eingeschaltet …

strings.context: Sentence in the AI model card after the download ended, the AI was off and is on now, and the running Hermes uses it.
strings.en: The AI model is installed. AI is now on: ncrs fills in fields for which there is no rule yet.
strings.de: Das KI-Modell ist installiert. Die KI ist jetzt an: ncrs füllt auch Felder aus, für die es noch keine Regel gibt.

strings.context: Sentence in the AI model card after the download ended and the AI switch was turned on, but the running Hermes cannot take it over now (files are being moved), so it applies at the next start.
strings.en: The AI model is installed. AI is on from the next start: ncrs then fills in fields for which there is no rule yet.
strings.de: Das KI-Modell ist installiert. Die KI ist ab dem nächsten Start an: ncrs füllt dann auch Felder aus, für die es noch keine Regel gibt.

strings.context: Sentence in the AI model card after the download ended while the AI was already switched on and was waiting for the file.
strings.en: The AI model is installed. ncrs uses it from now on.
strings.de: Das KI-Modell ist installiert. ncrs nutzt es ab jetzt.

strings.context: Sentence in the AI model card after the download ended while the Hermes switch on the Hermes page is off. The button below turns it on.
strings.en: The AI model is installed. Hermes is switched off, so it is not used yet.
strings.de: Das KI-Modell ist installiert. Hermes ist ausgeschaltet, daher wird es noch nicht genutzt.

strings.context: Button in the AI model card after the download that opens the setting which turns the AI on. Verb phrase.
Error in the AI model card when the download failed or the file did not pass the check. Takes the technical detail, which stays untranslated. A file that failed the check is never put in place.
Error in the AI model card when there is no data folder to save the model in.
strings.en: There is no data folder to save the model in.
strings.de: Es gibt keinen Datenordner, in dem das Modell gespeichert werden könnte.

strings.context: Review reason in the review list: no rule matched the document.
Review reason in the review list: the file is on hold because no text was recognised in it and its source is set to ask in that case.
Review reason in the review list: the file fits the rules of more than one target and its source is set to ask in that case.
Review reason in the review list: the user took the filing of this file back, so it waits for a new decision.
Review reason in the review list: a rule matched but is not confirmed yet.
Review reason in the review list: a file with the target name already exists.
Review reason in the review list: a field could not be read. Takes the field name.
Review reason in the review list: a field was read with low confidence. Takes the field name.
Form label in the review list: sender. Also names the field in a review reason.
Form label in the review list: recipient, the person or company the document is addressed to. Also names the field in a review reason.
Form label in the review list: kind of document. Also names the field in a review reason.
Form label in the review list: document date. Also names the field in a review reason.
Form label in the review list: document number. Also names the field in a review reason.
Form label in the review list: amount. Also names the field in a review reason.

Entry of the command list and the menu that runs the key action saved_queries, which opens the page of reports: saved searches for recurring questions over the index by year, sender, kind, tags and text, with an export of what they find. Also the title of that Hermes page and its sidebar entry.

Theme name of the key action saved_queries, shown dimmed after its plain name action.saved_queries in the command list, and matched when typing. A playful name (an inquiry, filed like a form); the plain name beside it says what the action does.
Shown on the saved queries page while the list loads.
Shown on the reports page when no report is saved yet. Names the button of the add row below.
strings.en: No reports yet. Choose + Report to make one, or start from a template.
strings.de: Noch keine Auswertungen. Wähle + Auswertung und lege eine an, auch aus einer Vorlage.

strings.context: Column header of the saved queries list: what the query asks for, in short.
Short form of a query without any criterion in the saved queries list: it finds every document.
Form label on the saved queries page: the year of the document date.
Form label on the reports page: the sender of the document.
Form label on the saved queries page: kind of document.
Form label on the saved queries page: tags.
Form label on the saved queries page: words that occur in the text of the document.
Button and report name of the template that finds the invoices of the current year.
Button and report name of the template that finds the contracts.
Button and report name of the template that finds the invoices that are not paid yet.
The tag that marks an invoice as not paid yet; the template for open invoices asks for it and the note names it. A single lowercase word.
Problem on the reports page: a report cannot be saved without a name.
Problem on the saved queries page. Takes the error detail.
Button in the add row under the list on the reports page: opens the dialog of a new report. Worded like the button that adds a rule, with a plus sign.
Label of the list of templates at the top of the dialog of a new report. The template fills in the name and the criteria.
First entry of the list of templates in the dialog of a new report: start with no criteria and no name.
Title of the dialog in which a new report is made.
Title of the dialog in which the name and criteria of an existing report are changed.
Link beside the criteria of a report: opens the search to change them.
Title of the section of the reports page that shows what the report finds.
Button on the saved queries page: saves the form as a query, or the change of the selected one.
Button on the saved queries page: opens the step that asks where to export the found files. Disabled while there is nothing to copy.
Button on the saved queries page: backs out of the export step.
Question on the reports page before a report is removed. Takes the name of the report.
strings.en: Remove the report ‘{name}’? Documents stay as they are.

strings.context: Button in the remove question of the reports page: removes the report. Also the title of that dialog.
Label of a figure under a run of a saved query: how many documents were found.
Label of a figure under a run of a report: the sum of the amounts of the found documents, one per currency.
Button under a run of a saved query: shows the found documents.
Button under a run of a saved query: hides the found documents.
Last line under the list of found documents when there are more than fit. Takes the number left out.
Heading of the export step on the saved queries page.
Label of the target folder of the export in the reports page.
Label of the number of files the export would copy.
Label of the name of the CSV file the export writes.
The pattern of the CSV file name shown in the export step; date and time of the export fill the placeholders.
Sentence in the export step: what the lines of the CSV file hold, in the order of its columns.
strings.en: One line per document: file name, name of the copy, original path, sender, kind, date, number, amount, currency, tags and whether it was copied.
strings.de: Eine Zeile je Dokument: Dateiname, Name der Kopie, Originalpfad, Absender, Art, Datum, Nummer, Betrag, Währung, Schlagworte und ob kopiert wurde.

strings.context: Sentence in the export step: what the export does and does not do.
strings.en: Copies only; moves and deletes nothing. Existing files stay untouched.
strings.de: Kopiert nur, verschiebt und löscht nichts. Vorhandene Dateien bleiben unangetastet.

strings.context: Button in the export step: opens the system dialog to choose the target folder.
Button in the export step: copies the files and writes the CSV.
Footer note on the saved queries page after an export. Takes the numbers and the CSV file name.
strings.en: Copied {copied}, skipped {existing} that exist and {missing} that are missing. CSV: {csv}
strings.de: {copied} kopiert, {existing} vorhandene und {missing} fehlende übersprungen. CSV: {csv}

strings.context: Entry of the command palette that runs the key action settings, which opens the settings as a tab. The plain name of what the action does, as short as a menu entry; the key bound to it is shown beside it.
Label of the third tab in the title bar while the settings are open. One word, noun.
Colored field at the left end of the status bar while the settings tab is open. Upper case, a single short word.
Text in the status bar while the settings tab is open: tells that a changed setting is already in effect and written to the file.
Right end of the status bar while the settings tab is open: how many settings were changed since the tab was opened. Takes the number.
Placeholder of the search field above the feature list on the settings tab. One word, verb.
Note at the bottom of the feature list on the settings tab. Says that the settings live in the file config.toml and that every change is written there. The file name stays as it is.
strings.en: Everything lives in config.toml. Every change here is written to it.
strings.de: Alles steht in config.toml. Jede Änderung hier schreibt dorthin.

strings.context: Shown on the settings tab when the search matches no feature and no setting.
Entry of the feature list on the settings tab: the look of the program, its color scheme. One word, noun.
Line under the heading of the appearance page on the settings tab: a color field left empty takes the color of the chosen scheme and VS Code theme.
strings.en: How ncrs looks. A color left empty comes from the scheme and the theme.
strings.de: Wie ncrs aussieht. Eine leere Farbe kommt aus dem Schema und dem Theme.

strings.context: Entry of the feature list on the settings tab: the language of the interface. One word, noun.
Line under the heading of the language page on the settings tab.
Entry of the feature list on the settings tab and title of its page: the tags (keywords) Hermes puts on documents.
Line under the heading of the tags page on the settings tab. Tags are the keywords Hermes attaches to documents.
strings.en: Names Hermes attaches to files. A tick shows the tag in the file list behind the file name.
strings.de: Namen, die Hermes an Dateien hängt. Ein Haken zeigt das Schlagwort in der Dateiliste hinter dem Dateinamen.

strings.context: Entry of the feature list on the settings tab and title of its page: saved searches that count and list matching documents, like a report.
Line under the heading of the reports page on the settings tab. A report is a saved search whose hits are counted and can be exported.
strings.en: Saved searches that count what they find. Exporting copies the hits into a folder; the originals stay where they are.
strings.de: Gespeicherte Suchen, die zählen, was sie finden. Exportieren kopiert die Treffer in einen Ordner, die Originale bleiben, wo sie sind.

strings.context: Entry of the feature list on the settings tab and title of its page: the files the index could not read.
Line under the heading of the read errors page on the settings tab. The page lists files the index could not read and lets the user try them again.
strings.en: Files ncrs could not read, and why. Process again tries a file once more.
strings.de: Dateien, die ncrs nicht lesen konnte, und warum. Erneut verarbeiten versucht es noch einmal.

strings.context: Entry of the feature list on the settings tab and title of its page: what Hermes does right now and what it has filed lately.
Line under the heading of the activity page on the settings tab. The page shows the state of Hermes and the runs that moved files, newest first.
strings.en: What Hermes does now, and the latest runs that moved files, newest first.
strings.de: Was Hermes gerade tut, und die letzten Läufe, die Dateien bewegt haben, neueste zuerst.

strings.context: Line on the reviews and the activity page of the settings while the index is being read.
Last line of a group on the reviews and activity pages that lists only the first files. {count} is how many more files the group has, 1 or more.
Button on a file row of the reviews and activity pages. Shows the file in the file list of the active panel.
Reason in the error line after a file was not filed, when the reason comes as text from the operating system. {file} is the file name, {reason} the operating system's message, not translated.
Title of the first section of the activity page: what Hermes does at this moment.
Title of the second section of the activity page: the runs that moved files, newest first.
Line on the activity page when Hermes is not running.
Button on the activity page that opens the read errors page. {count} is the number of files that could not be read.
Line on the activity page when Hermes has not moved any file yet.
strings.en: No file has been moved yet.

strings.context: Title of a run on the activity page: Hermes filed documents into the archive.
Title of a run on the activity page: a run the user started in the chat.
Title of a run on the activity page: the files of a folder were rearranged.
Added after the time of a run on the activity page when the user took the run back.
Entry of the feature list on the settings tab and title of its page: what Hermes used on the own AI server, in requests, tokens and money.
Line under the heading of the usage page on the settings tab. Hermes is the module that sorts documents; the own server is an AI server the user set up.
strings.en: What Hermes used on your own server. Kept only on this computer.
strings.de: Was Hermes auf deinem eigenen Server verbraucht hat. Bleibt nur auf diesem Rechner.

strings.context: Shown on the usage page when Hermes has not yet asked the own server anything.
Shown at the top of the usage page when the file that records the requests to the own server could not be read, so the sums may be too low. Takes the reason from the system.
strings.en: The usage log could not be read, so the figures may be incomplete: {reason}
strings.de: Das Nutzungsprotokoll ließ sich nicht lesen, die Zahlen können daher unvollständig sein: {reason}

strings.context: Heading of the first section of the usage page: the main numbers of the chosen period.
Label before the buttons that choose how far back the usage page looks.
Button that chooses a period on the usage page. {days} is a number.
Label over a number on the usage page: the money the server charged in the period.
Label over a number on the usage page: how many times Hermes asked the server.
Label over a number on the usage page: tokens are the pieces of text an AI model reads and writes, what servers count and charge for.
Label over a number on the usage page: the share of the text sent that the server had already seen and served from its cache, which is cheaper and faster.
Label over a number on the usage page: the money per one million tokens.
Shown in place of a money number on the usage page when the server does not say what a request cost.
Line under the numbers on the usage page. {priced} and {total} are numbers of requests.
strings.en: Money only where the server reports a price: {priced} of {total} requests.
strings.de: Kosten nur dort, wo der Server einen Preis meldet: {priced} von {total} Anfragen.

strings.context: Heading of the section of the usage page with a bar chart: the tokens of each day.
Line under the bar chart on the usage page: the busiest day. {tokens} is a short number such as 12.4k, {day} a date.
Legend entry of the bar chart on the usage page: all models that do not have a colour of their own.
Heading of the last section of the usage page: one bar for each AI model that was used.
Line under the bar of a model on the usage page. {requests} is a number, {percent} a number from 0 to 100, {cost} an amount of money.
Line under the bar of a model on the usage page when the server reports no price. {requests} is a number, {percent} a number from 0 to 100.
strings.en: {requests} requests · {percent} % from cache · no price reported
strings.de: {requests} Anfragen · {percent} % aus dem Cache · kein Preis gemeldet

strings.context: Like the usage model detail line, for a model that was asked exactly once. {percent} a number from 0 to 100, {cost} an amount of money.
Like the usage model detail line without a price, for a model that was asked exactly once. {percent} a number from 0 to 100.
strings.en: 1 request · {percent} % from cache · no price reported
strings.de: 1 Anfrage · {percent} % aus dem Cache · kein Preis gemeldet

strings.context: Name of a setting on the appearance page: which built-in color scheme the look starts from.
Explanation under the color scheme setting: colors from a VS Code theme or from the theme section of the file are laid over the scheme chosen here.
strings.en: The built-in look. Colors of a VS Code theme or of [theme] come on top.
strings.de: Das eingebaute Aussehen. Farben eines VS-Code-Themes oder aus [theme] kommen darüber.

strings.context: Name of the built-in color scheme Cosmic, the calm dark grey look that earlier versions had without any setting. A proper name; keep it.
Name of the built-in color scheme with the earlier dark teal look. A proper name or a plain color word.
Name of the built-in color scheme Classic, the look of the old two-panel file managers.
Name of the built-in color scheme Dracula. A proper name; keep it.
Name of a setting on the appearance page: the VS Code color theme file laid over the color scheme.
Explanation under the VS Code theme setting: a theme file chosen on disk is laid over the color scheme.
strings.en: A theme file (JSON), laid over the color scheme.
strings.de: Eine Theme-Datei (JSON), über das Farbschema gelegt.

strings.context: Value of the VS Code theme setting when the config names no theme file.
Button next to the VS Code theme setting that opens the card to download a theme. The ellipsis says a card follows.
Name of the setting on the language page: the language of the interface.
Explanation under the language setting: what is chosen here is written to the file, while the quick switch of the function key row only lasts for the session.
strings.en: Written to config.toml. The quick switch lasts for the session only.
strings.de: Wird in die config.toml geschrieben. Der Schnellwechsel gilt nur für diese Sitzung.

strings.context: Name of the switch on the Updates page of the settings tab that turns on the daily check for a newer version of ncrs. The switch itself shows On or Off.
Explanation under the update check switch on the Updates page: once a day ncrs asks GitHub for the newest version number. Nothing else is sent, no file names, no identifiers.
strings.en: Asks GitHub once a day for the newest version. Only the request itself is sent.
strings.de: Fragt einmal am Tag bei GitHub nach der neuesten Version. Gesendet wird nur die Anfrage selbst.

strings.context: Label of the switch under the language setting: whether the names from the Futurama show are shown next to the plain names. Short, a row label.
Explanation under the Futurama names switch: the names from the show appear next to the plain ones. Smell-o-scope is the show's name for the search; the plain name is Search.
strings.en: Shows the names from the show next to the plain ones, e.g. Smell-o-scope next to Search.
strings.de: Zeigt die Namen aus der Serie neben den Klartext-Namen, z. B. Smell-o-scope neben Suche.

strings.context: Value of a switched on setting on the settings tab, next to its checkbox. One word.
Value of a switched off setting on the settings tab, next to its checkbox. One word.
Status of the text recognition models or the AI model when the files are not there. Lower case.
Button next to a model setting that opens the card to download the model. The ellipsis says a card follows.

Label of the choice on the AI page of the settings tab that tells where the AI model runs: on this computer or on a server. Question; the two answers are the segments beside it, the word server is meant to be searchable.
Description under the choice on the AI page of the settings tab that tells where the AI model runs. The words computer and server are meant to be searchable.
strings.en: On this computer or on your own server.
strings.de: Auf diesem Computer oder auf deinem eigenen Server.

strings.context: Segment of the choice where the AI model runs: on this computer. Short.
Value of the AI provider setting when the model runs on a server named in the file.
Notice in the status bar after a setting was written to the file but only takes effect when the program starts again.
strings.en: Saved in config.toml. Takes effect at the next start.
strings.de: In der config.toml gespeichert. Gilt ab dem nächsten Start.

strings.context: Entry of the feature list on the settings tab: the programs that view and edit files (F3 and F4). One word, noun.
Line under the heading of the programs page on the settings tab.
strings.en: The programs that open a file (F3, F4) and a folder (terminal).
strings.de: Die Programme, die eine Datei (F3, F4) und einen Ordner (Terminal) öffnen.

strings.context: Entry of the feature list on the settings tab: which keys run which command.
Line under the heading of the keyboard shortcuts page on the settings tab.
Name of a setting on the programs page: the program F3 opens a file with to look at it.
Explanation under the viewer setting: it applies to file types without a row of their own in the F3-by-file-type block below; an empty field means the system opens the file with its own program.
strings.en: For all file types without a row of their own below. Empty: the system default.
strings.de: Für alle Dateitypen ohne eigene Zeile unten. Leer: das System entscheidet.

strings.context: Name of a setting on the programs page: the program F4 opens a file with to change it.
Explanation under the editor setting: an empty field means the viewer or the system default is used; the words {path} and {line} in an argument stand for the file and the line.
strings.en: Empty: the viewer or the system default. {path} and {line} stand for the file and the line.
strings.de: Leer: der Betrachter oder das System. {path} und {line} stehen für Datei und Zeile.

strings.context: Added to the explanation of the viewer and editor settings in the App Store version, which may only start apps.
strings.en: The App Store version can only open apps.
strings.de: Die App-Store-Version kann nur Apps öffnen.

strings.context: Placeholder in the empty viewer or editor field on the programs page: the operating system decides which program opens the file.
Button on the settings tab that opens the system dialog to pick a file. The ellipsis says a dialog follows.
Button on the settings tab that removes a program or file from the config so the built-in behaviour applies again.
Button next to the VS Code theme setting that stops using the theme file. One word, verb.
Name of a setting on the appearance page: downloading a VS Code theme from the Open VSX registry. Open VSX is a proper name.
Explanation under the Open VSX setting: a theme is downloaded by its ID or its link, or from an https link to a VS Code theme file (.json), and then used.
strings.en: Downloads a theme by its ID or link, or from an https link to a theme .json file, and uses it.
strings.de: Lädt ein Theme über seine ID oder seinen Link oder von einem https-Link auf eine Theme-.json-Datei und verwendet es.

strings.context: Shown under the VS Code theme setting when the theme file could not be used in full. Takes the reason, which is English and stays untranslated.
Heading of the group of color settings on the appearance page: one row per part of the window.
Name of a color setting on the appearance page: the background of the whole window.
Name of a color setting on the appearance page: the background of the two file panels.
Name of a color setting on the appearance page: the normal text color.
Name of a color setting on the appearance page: text that matters less, such as notes and disabled entries.
Name of a color setting on the appearance page: the names of folders in the panels.
Name of a color setting on the appearance page: the bar on the current row of a panel.
Name of a color setting on the appearance page: the text on the cursor bar and in the title bar.
Name of a color setting on the appearance page: rows the user marked for a command.
Name of a color setting on the appearance page: the frame of the active panel.
Name of a color setting on the appearance page: the title bar of the active panel.
Name of a color setting on the appearance page: the title bar and frame of the inactive panel.
Name of a color setting on the appearance page: the bar at the bottom of the window.
Name of a color setting on the appearance page: the background of dialogs and cards.
Name of a color setting on the appearance page: the background of menus and the command list.
Name of a color setting on the appearance page: the color that highlights, such as shortcut letters.
Name of a color setting on the appearance page: messages about something that worked.
Name of a color setting on the appearance page: error messages.
Shown under a color setting whose text color is hard to read on its background. Takes the name of the background color setting and the contrast ratio, such as 2.1.
Sentence under the title of the group of own details in the Hermes settings page.
strings.en: So that ncrs does not take you or your company for the sender.
strings.de: Damit ncrs dich und deine Firma nicht für den Absender hält.

strings.context: Label of the setting listing the own names and companies of the user; they are never taken for a sender.
Label of the setting listing the bank accounts (IBAN) of the user; they are never taken for the account of a sender.
Label of the setting listing the tax numbers of the user; they are never taken for the tax number of a sender.
Placeholder of the field where an own name or company is typed; Enter adds it.
Placeholder of the field where an own IBAN is typed; Enter adds it.
Placeholder of the field where an own tax number is typed; Enter adds it.
Shown under the field for an own IBAN when the typed value is not a valid IBAN.
strings.en: That is not a valid IBAN.

strings.context: Shown under a color setting when the typed value is not a color: it must be a # with six or three hex digits.
Shown under the viewer or editor setting when the typed line has no program in front.
Shown under the viewer or editor setting when the typed line contains a NUL character, which no program can take.
Shown under the viewer or editor setting when the program is a relative path, which would depend on the folder ncrs started in.
strings.en: Use a program name from PATH or an absolute path.
strings.de: Bitte einen Programmnamen aus PATH oder einen absoluten Pfad.

strings.context: Shown under the viewer or editor setting when a quote in the typed line is opened but not closed.
Shown under the viewer or editor setting in the App Store version when the picked file is not an app.
strings.en: Only an app can be chosen here.
strings.de: Hier lässt sich nur eine App wählen.

strings.context: Shown on the settings tab when the path of a picked file has characters the config file cannot hold.
strings.en: The path of this file cannot be saved.
strings.de: Der Pfad dieser Datei lässt sich nicht speichern.

strings.context: Status bar notice in the sandboxed app after a VS Code theme file was picked: the theme includes a second file that could not be copied next to it, so the theme loads without that file's colors. {include} is the included file's name, {reason} says why (the next entry or a system error).
strings.en: The theme includes {include}, which could not be copied ({reason}). It loads without those colours.
strings.de: Das Theme bindet {include} ein, die Datei ließ sich nicht kopieren ({reason}). Es lädt ohne diese Farben.

strings.context: The {reason} of the previous entry when the included file's name points outside the picked theme's folder (.. or an absolute path).
strings.en: it lies outside the theme's folder

strings.context: Shown under the endpoint setting when the typed address cannot be used. Takes the reason, which is English and stays untranslated.
Shown under the endpoint setting when the address starts with http:// and names another computer. Only https is allowed for another computer; plain http is for this computer only.
strings.en: Plain http is only for this computer. Use https.
strings.de: Einfaches http gilt nur für diesen Rechner. Nimm https.

strings.context: Shown under the endpoint or model name setting when it is empty but the own server needs it.
Name of a setting on the AI page of the settings tab: the web address of the own AI server.
Explanation under the endpoint setting of the own AI server: the address of a server that speaks the OpenAI API, which many AI services and programs do.
strings.en: The address of a server that speaks the OpenAI API.
strings.de: Die Adresse eines Servers, der die OpenAI-Schnittstelle spricht.

strings.context: Name of a setting in the own server dialog: the API key, a secret password that the server asks for. Shortest word for it.
Explanation under the key field in the own server dialog. The keychain is the password store of the operating system.
strings.en: Kept in the keychain of this computer. Empty for a server without a key.
strings.de: Liegt im Schlüsselbund dieses Rechners. Leer für einen Server ohne Schlüssel.

strings.context: Button in the own server dialog: asks the server whether it answers and which models it offers.
Status beside the Test connection button while the server has not answered yet.
Status beside the Test connection button: the server answered and lists its models. {count} is a number.
Status beside the Test connection button: the server answered but cannot tell which models it has, so the model name is typed by hand.
strings.en: Connected. The server does not list its models.
strings.de: Verbunden. Der Server nennt seine Modelle nicht.

strings.context: Status beside the Test connection button: the server said the API key is wrong or missing.
strings.de: Der Server hat den Schlüssel abgelehnt.

strings.context: Status beside the Test connection button: the server answered, but with an HTTP error. Takes the status code, for example 400.

Line in the Hermes overview about the AI server on another computer: a request was held back because the user has not allowed that kind of data yet, so those documents wait. Points to the settings page.
strings.en: Documents wait: sending them to the server is not allowed yet (Settings, AI).
strings.de: Dokumente warten: sie an den Server zu senden ist noch nicht freigegeben (Einstellungen, KI).

strings.context: Status beside the Test connection button: no connection could be made or the server was too slow.
Caption of the model menu in the own server dialog while no model is chosen yet. The menu lists the models the server offers.
Heading of the section of the AI page of the settings tab that lists what goes to an AI server on another computer. Only shown for such a server.
First paragraph of the section about sending data to an AI server on another computer. The three rows below are three separate agreements; each lists what it covers.
strings.en: You agree to each kind of data on its own. Of a kind you have not allowed, nothing is sent.
strings.de: Du stimmst jeder Art von Daten einzeln zu. Von einer Art, die du nicht freigegeben hast, wird nichts gesendet.

strings.context: Dim line above the three rows about sending data to an AI server on another computer, shown when the settings file had the one agreement of an older version. That agreement no longer counts; the user allows each kind again.
strings.en: Allowing a server is now split by kind of data. Please allow again what may go to this server.
strings.de: Die Freigabe ist jetzt nach Art getrennt. Bitte gib neu frei, was an den Server darf.

strings.context: First line under the label of one of three agreements about sending data to an AI server on another computer; the list of what the agreement covers follows. The agreement is given for each server. The word server is meant to be searchable.
strings.de: Freigabe für diesen Server, gilt für:

strings.context: Label of one of three agreements about sending data to an AI server on another computer: new documents that arrive in a folder Hermes watches and that Hermes reads to sort them. Hermes is the module that sorts documents.

Label of one of three agreements about sending data to an AI server on another computer: texts and data of documents that are already filed (the archive), which the chat and the rule learning of Hermes show to the model.

Label of one of three agreements about sending data to an AI server on another computer: the folder structure with the file names, which the model sees when it chooses a folder, learns how a folder is organised or proposes a file name pattern.
Last line under the row about folders and file names in the AI page: suggesting rules sends data of two kinds, so both agreements are needed. Filed documents is the name of the other row.
strings.en: Suggesting rules needs this agreement and the one for filed documents.
strings.de: Regeln vorzuschlagen braucht diese Freigabe und die für abgelegte Dokumente.

strings.context: Status in the row about sending data to an AI server on another computer: the user agreed. Short, dim.
Status in the row about sending data to an AI server on another computer: the user has not agreed yet, so nothing is sent. The button Allow follows. Short.

One point of the list of what goes to the AI model on another computer: the documents Hermes sorts into folders. Hermes is the module that sorts documents. Text recognition turns scans and photos into text.
strings.en: The text of every document Hermes reads to sort it, including the text recognised in scans and photos, also of all documents in sources, targets and the folders of the index, again after updates.
strings.de: Der Text jedes Dokuments, das Hermes zum Einsortieren liest, auch der Text, der in Scans und Fotos erkannt wurde, auch von allen Dokumenten in Quellen, Zielen und Ordnern des Index, erneut nach Updates.

strings.context: One point of the list of what goes to the AI model on another computer: the chat with Hermes (the module that sorts documents). File and folder names can be part of the question.
strings.en: Everything you write to Hermes in the chat, the last question Hermes asked with its answer options (including file and folder names in them), and your previous request and message that the new one refers to.
strings.de: Alles, was du im Chat an Hermes schreibst, die letzte Frage von Hermes mit ihren Antwortmöglichkeiten (samt darin genannter Datei- und Ordnernamen) und deine vorige Anfrage und Nachricht, auf die sich die neue bezieht.

strings.context: One point of the list of what goes to the AI model on another computer: what Hermes (the module that sorts documents) shows the model when you ask it to suggest rules for a target. A target is a folder where files are filed into.
strings.en: When you ask Hermes to suggest rules for a target: the folders and file names of up to 12 sample documents per folder of the target and what Hermes found in them (sender, recipient, kind, date, number, tags).
strings.de: Wenn du Hermes bittest, Regeln für ein Ziel vorzuschlagen: die Ordner und Dateinamen von bis zu 12 Beispieldokumenten je Ordner des Ziels und was Hermes darin gefunden hat (Absender, Empfänger, Art, Datum, Nummer, Tags).

strings.context: One point of the list of what goes to the AI model on another computer: what Hermes shows the model when you ask it for a rule for one file that no rule takes. A target is a folder where files are filed into.
strings.en: When you ask Hermes for a rule for one file: what Hermes found in that file (sender, kind), the folders of up to 12 sample documents of the target and what Hermes found in them (sender, recipient, kind, date, number, tags).
strings.de: Wenn du Hermes um eine Regel für eine Datei bittest: was Hermes in der Datei gefunden hat (Absender, Art), die Ordner von bis zu 12 Beispieldokumenten des Ziels und was Hermes darin gefunden hat (Absender, Empfänger, Art, Datum, Nummer, Tags).

strings.context: One point of the list of what goes to the AI model on another computer: what Hermes (the module that sorts documents) shows the model when it works out how a folder is organised.
strings.en: When Hermes works out how a folder is organised: the folders and file names of sample documents and what Hermes found in them (sender, recipient, kind, date, number, tags).
strings.de: Wenn Hermes erkennt, wie ein Ordner aufgebaut ist: die Ordner und Dateinamen von Beispieldokumenten und was Hermes darin gefunden hat (Absender, Empfänger, Art, Datum, Nummer, Tags).

strings.context: One point of the list of what goes to the AI model on another computer: the file names the batch rename dialog shows the model to propose a name pattern. SFTP is a way to reach files on a server.
strings.en: When you rename several files at once: the names of up to 30 files of the folder, also in folders on another computer (SFTP).
strings.de: Wenn du mehrere Dateien auf einmal umbenennst: die Namen von bis zu 30 Dateien des Ordners, auch in Ordnern auf einem anderen Rechner (SFTP).

strings.context: Last paragraph of the section about sending data to a server on another computer, below the list of what is sent.
strings.en: What the server does with this is up to whoever runs it. You can switch back to the model on this computer at any time. The approval holds for this one server only.
strings.de: Was der Server damit macht, entscheidet, wer ihn betreibt. Du kannst jederzeit zum Modell auf diesem Rechner zurückwechseln. Die Freigabe gilt nur für diesen einen Server.

strings.context: Button beside the status not allowed yet: the user agrees that the listed data is sent to the AI server on another computer. Saves the server too. Verb.
Button beside the status allowed: the user takes back the agreement to send this kind of data to the AI server on another computer. Nothing of that kind is sent afterwards. Verb.
Shown when the API key could not be put in the keychain (the password store of the operating system). {reason} is the system's explanation.
strings.en: The address was saved, but the key could not be stored in the keychain: {reason}
strings.de: Die Adresse ist gespeichert, aber der Schlüssel konnte nicht im Schlüsselbund abgelegt werden: {reason}

strings.context: Button in the Connection row of the AI page that writes address, key and model of the own server. Verb.
Name of a setting in the AI group of the filing page: the name of the model on the own server.
Explanation under the model name setting: the name the server knows the model by.
strings.en: The name the server knows the model by.
strings.de: Der Name, unter dem der Server das Modell kennt.

strings.context: Name of the setting on the keyboard shortcuts page: the keys of all commands, changed in a dialog.
Explanation under the keys setting: the dialog lists every command, finds one by name or by its key and records new keys.
strings.en: Find a command by name or key and record new keys.
strings.de: Einen Befehl über Namen oder Taste finden und neue Tasten aufnehmen.

strings.context: Value of the keys setting: how many commands have keys of the user's own. Takes the number.
Value of the keys setting when every command has the keys it ships with.
Button on the keyboard shortcuts page that opens the keyboard shortcuts dialog. The ellipsis says a dialog follows.
Box at the top of the settings tab when the config file does not load: nothing can be saved until it is fixed. Takes the file path and the reason, which is English and stays untranslated.
strings.en: The config file {path} cannot be used: {reason}. Nothing is saved until it is fixed.
strings.de: Die Konfigurationsdatei {path} ist nicht verwendbar: {reason}. Bis sie behoben ist, wird nichts gespeichert.

strings.context: Box at the top of the settings tab when the config file has an error at a known line: nothing can be saved until it is fixed. Takes the file path, the line number and the reason, which is English and stays untranslated.
strings.en: The config file {path} has an error in line {line}: {reason}. Nothing is saved until it is fixed.
strings.de: Die Konfigurationsdatei {path} hat einen Fehler in Zeile {line}: {reason}. Bis sie behoben ist, wird nichts gespeichert.

strings.context: Title of the copy dialog and label of its primary button. Imperative verb, one word.
Title of the move dialog and label of its primary button. Imperative verb, one word.

Dimmed text after the title of the copy and move dialog: how many top-level entries are selected and how large they are. {count} is two or more, {size} is a size like 4.2 GB or an ellipsis while the folders are still being counted.
Same as transfer.summary for exactly one selected entry. {size} is a size or an ellipsis while it is counted.
Part of the line under a file panel: how many files the panel shows, two or more. {count} is the number.
Same as panel_footer.files for exactly one file.
Part of the line under a file panel: how many folders the panel shows, two or more. {count} is the number.
Same as panel_footer.folders for exactly one folder.
Line under a file panel when nothing is selected. {files} and {folders} are the counted parts, for example '24 files' and '3 folders'; {size} is the total size of the files, for example 182.4 MB.
Line under a file panel when entries are selected. {selected} and {total} are numbers of entries (files and folders), {selected_size} and {total_size} are sizes like 12.1 MB.

Line under a file panel when the size of some folders has not been computed yet, so the total leaves them out. {line} is the whole line as it would be otherwise, for example '24 files, 3 folders · 182.4 MB'.
Label above the number of files in the copy and move dialog when many entries are selected. Plural noun, one word.
Label above the number of folders in the copy and move dialog when many entries are selected. Plural noun, one word.
Label above the total size in the copy and move dialog when many entries are selected. Noun, one word.
Label above the number of entries the size count could not read in the copy and move dialog. Only shown when there are some. Short adjective phrase.
The first names of a large selection, then how many more there are. {names} is a comma separated list of file names, {count} the number left out.
Button in the copy and move dialog that unfolds the list of all selected names. Short verb phrase.
Button in the copy and move dialog that folds the list of selected names away again. Short verb phrase.
Last line of the unfolded name list when it is cut off: how many names are not shown. {count} is the number left out.
Warning in the copy and move dialog: some selected names already exist in the target folder. {count} is two or more.
strings.en: {count} of these names already exist in the target
strings.de: Im Ziel gibt es schon {count} dieser Namen

strings.context: Same as transfer.conflicts for exactly one name that already exists in the target folder.
strings.en: One of these names already exists in the target
strings.de: Im Ziel gibt es schon einen dieser Namen

strings.context: Label of the target folder field in the copy and move dialog, also its placeholder. One word, a preposition.
Label of the choice in the copy and move dialog for what happens when the target already has a name. Reads as the start of a sentence.
strings.de: Wenn es den Namen schon gibt

strings.context: Option of the choice for an existing name: ask for each file that is in the way. One word.
Option of the choice for an existing name: replace the file in the target without asking. One word.
Option of the choice for an existing name: leave the file in the target alone and go on. One word.
Hint in the footer of the copy and move dialog: the Tab key switches between the two. Starts with the key name, keep it.
Error under the target field when the typed folder does not exist.
Error under the target field when the typed path is a file, not a folder.
strings.en: The target is not a folder

strings.context: Error under the target field when the target is the folder the selected entries are already in.
strings.en: Source and target are the same folder
strings.de: Quelle und Ziel sind derselbe Ordner

strings.context: Error under the target field when the user wants to move (F6) entries into an archive or a folder inside one. Only copying into an archive works, because a move would delete the originals after rewriting the archive.
strings.en: Files can only be copied into an archive, not moved
strings.de: In ein Archiv lässt sich nur kopieren, nicht verschieben

strings.context: Error under the target field when entries of one archive are to go into another archive, or the target lies inside an archive that is itself inside an archive. Neither is supported; copying out to a folder first works.
strings.en: Archives inside archives are not supported; copy the files out to a folder first
strings.de: Archive in Archiven werden nicht unterstützt; erst in einen Ordner herauskopieren

strings.context: Error under the target field when files on an SFTP server are to be copied into an archive. Copying them to a folder on this computer first works.
strings.en: Files from a server cannot go straight into an archive; copy them to a folder first
strings.de: Dateien von einem Server gehen nicht direkt in ein Archiv; erst in einen Ordner kopieren

strings.context: Error under the target field when the user wants to move (F6) entries out of an archive. Archives are read only, so only copying works.
strings.en: Files can only be copied out of an archive, not moved
strings.de: Aus einem Archiv lässt sich nur kopieren, nicht verschieben

strings.context: Error under the target field when a selected folder would be copied or moved into itself or one of its subfolders.
strings.en: A folder cannot go into itself
strings.de: Ein Ordner kann nicht in sich selbst

strings.context: Error under the target field when the system would not say whether the target folder can be used, for example for lack of permission.
strings.de: Das Ziel lässt sich nicht lesen

strings.context: Error under the target field when the folder of a selected file or folder is gone or cannot be read any more while the dialog is open, for example because it was renamed or its drive was removed. The target itself is fine.
strings.en: A selected item can no longer be found
strings.de: Ein ausgewählter Eintrag ist nicht mehr zu finden

strings.context: Dimmed text after the title of the progress dialog of a copy or move: where it goes. {target} is the folder path.
Button of the progress dialog that closes it while the copy or move goes on. Short, like a mode name.
Hint in the footer of the progress dialog: the Escape key stops the job. Starts with the key name, keep it.
Status bar message after files were excluded from Hermes by the quick-fix menu. {count} is their number.
Entry of the Hermes submenu of the context menu and the command list; acts on the file under the cursor. Runs the file through the pipeline steps again.

Entry of the Hermes submenu of the context menu; acts on the folder under the cursor. Opens the plan that files the folder's files into the targets, for one time. The ellipsis says a plan or a dialog follows.

Entry of the Hermes submenu of the context menu; acts on the folder under the cursor. Opens the dialog that makes the folder a source: Hermes watches it and files new files. The ellipsis says a dialog follows.
Entry of the Hermes submenu of the context menu, instead of hermes_menu.watch_source for a folder that is a source. Opens the dialog of that source. The ellipsis says a dialog follows.

Entry of the Hermes submenu of the context menu; acts on the folder under the cursor. Opens the dialog that makes the folder a target, a folder documents are filed into. The ellipsis says a dialog follows.
Entry of the Hermes submenu of the context menu, instead of hermes_menu.add_target for a folder that is a target. Opens the dialog of that target. The ellipsis says a dialog follows.
Entry of the Hermes submenu of the context menu and the command list; acts on the file under the cursor. Hermes leaves the file or folder alone from now on.
Entry of the Hermes submenu of the context menu and the command list; acts on the file under the cursor. Takes back an exclusion.
Entry of the Hermes submenu of the context menu and the command list; acts on the file under the cursor. Opens the Read errors page, at the file's error if it has one.
Status bar message after several files, or the documents of a folder, were queued to run through the Hermes steps again. Takes the number of files (more than one).
Status bar message after a file was queued to run through the Hermes steps again. {name} is the file name.
Status bar text while Hermes is rebuilt after the AI setting changed. It stands where the idle line of Hermes stands.
Status bar text while Hermes reads one file again. Takes the file name.
Status bar text while Hermes reads several files again. Takes the file name of the last one asked and the number of the others.
Notice when a file read again got its place from the rules and is filed. Takes the file name.
Notice when a file read again could not be placed and waits for the user in the review list. Takes the file name.
Notice when reading a file again failed. Takes the file name and the reason, which stays as the pipeline worded it.
Notice when a file read again led to the same result as before. Takes the file name.
strings.de: {name}: unverändert, der Inhalt ergibt nichts Neues

strings.context: Notice when a file read again is finished and there is nothing more to say about it, for example after Hermes was rebuilt meanwhile. Takes the file name.
Notice after the button of the review list queued the open reviews to be read again with the AI. Takes the number of documents (more than one).
Notice after the button of the review list queued its single open review to be read again with the AI.
Status bar message when a file cannot be run through the Hermes steps: it is excluded, outside the configured folders, or the pipeline is not running.
strings.en: Hermes cannot process this file now
strings.de: Hermes kann diese Datei jetzt nicht verarbeiten

strings.context: Status bar message after a file or folder was taken back into Hermes' view. {name} is its name.
Status bar message when a file cannot be included because a folder around it is excluded. {folder} is that folder's path.
strings.en: Excluded by the folder {folder}; include that folder instead
strings.de: Vom Ordner {folder} ausgeschlossen; schließe stattdessen den Ordner wieder ein

strings.context: Status bar message when the user starts a Hermes command while the filing module is switched off; the settings page with the switch opens at the same time. A whole sentence.
strings.en: Hermes is off. Switch it on here to sort your documents.
strings.de: Hermes ist aus. Schalte ihn hier ein, um deine Dokumente zu sortieren.

strings.context: Status bar message when saving a folder's role failed. {reason} is the cause.
Entry of the command list and the menu that runs the key action hermes_process_again: runs the file under the cursor through the Hermes steps again.
Entry of the command list and the menu that runs the key action hermes_file_once: opens the plan that files the files of the folder under the cursor into the targets, for one time.
Entry of the command list and the menu that runs the key action watch_source: opens the dialog that makes the folder under the cursor a source Hermes watches, or the dialog of the source it is.

Entry of the command list and the menu that runs the key action add_target: opens the dialog that makes the folder under the cursor a target documents are filed into, or the dialog of the target it is.
Entry of the command list and the menu that runs the key action hermes_exclude: excludes the file or folder under the cursor from Hermes, or includes it again when it is excluded.
strings.en: Exclude from or include in Hermes
strings.de: Von Hermes ausschließen oder wieder einbeziehen

strings.context: Entry of the command list and the menu that runs the key action hermes_inspect: opens the Read errors page for the file under the cursor.
Label of the F2 slot in the function key bar at the bottom of the window. The key opens the chat with Hermes, the assistant that tidies and finds documents; at most 8 characters.

Entry of the command palette that runs the key action hermes_chat, which opens the chat with Hermes, the assistant. The plain name of what the action does, as short as a menu entry; the key bound to it is shown beside it.
Entry of the command palette that runs the key action command_line. The plain name of what the action does, as short as a menu entry; the key bound to it is shown beside it.
Dim label at the right end of the command line while it is empty and does not have the focus, beside the key cap of the key that focuses it.
Right end of the command line while shell commands started from it are still running. {count} is the number of running commands.
Status bar notice when a command typed into the command line ended with an exit status. {command} is the typed line, {code} the exit status number.
Status bar error when a command typed into the command line was ended by a signal and so has no exit status. {command} is the typed line.
Status bar error when the shell for a command typed into the command line could not be started. {command} is the typed line, {reason} the system's explanation.
strings.de: {command}: Die Shell ließ sich nicht starten: {reason}

strings.context: Status bar error when a command typed into the command line was not run because the folder shown is a Windows network path (starting with two backslashes), which the Windows command shell cannot use as working folder. {command} is the typed line.
strings.en: {command}: not run, the Windows command shell cannot work in a network folder
strings.de: {command}: nicht ausgeführt, die Windows-Eingabeaufforderung kann nicht in einem Netzwerkordner arbeiten

strings.context: Entry of the command palette that runs the key action key_bindings, which opens the dialog listing every keyboard shortcut. The plain name of what the action does, as short as a menu entry; the key bound to it is shown beside it.
Name of the key action cursor_up in the keyboard shortcuts dialog: moves the cursor of the file panel one row up. As short as a menu entry.
Name of the key action cursor_down in the keyboard shortcuts dialog: moves the cursor of the file panel one row down. As short as a menu entry.
Name of the key action page_up in the keyboard shortcuts dialog: moves the cursor of the file panel one page up. As short as a menu entry.
Name of the key action page_down in the keyboard shortcuts dialog: moves the cursor of the file panel one page down. As short as a menu entry.
Name of the key action first in the keyboard shortcuts dialog: moves the cursor of the file panel to its first row. As short as a menu entry.
Name of the key action last in the keyboard shortcuts dialog: moves the cursor of the file panel to its last row. As short as a menu entry.
Name of the key action tag_up in the keyboard shortcuts dialog: tags the row under the cursor and moves the cursor one row up. As short as a menu entry.
Name of the key action tag_down in the keyboard shortcuts dialog: tags the row under the cursor and moves the cursor one row down. As short as a menu entry.
Title of the dialog that lists every keyboard shortcut and lets the user rebind them.
Playful theme name shown dimmed next to the title of the keyboard shortcuts dialog, in the Futurama theme of the app: the switchboard of the Planet Express ship.
Placeholder of the search field of the keyboard shortcuts dialog. Typing searches the action names; pressing a key combination finds the action bound to it.
strings.en: Search by name, or press a key combination
strings.de: Nach Namen suchen oder Tastenkombination drücken

strings.context: Column heading in the keyboard shortcuts dialog over the names of the actions.
Column heading in the keyboard shortcuts dialog over the menu group an action belongs to (File, Edit, View ...).
Column heading in the keyboard shortcuts dialog over the keys bound to each action.
Small tag in a row of the keyboard shortcuts dialog when the action does not have the keys the app ships with. One short word.
Shown dimmed in a row of the keyboard shortcuts dialog when no key is bound to the action.
Shown in the row being rebound in the keyboard shortcuts dialog while the app waits for the new key combination.
Footer note of the keyboard shortcuts dialog while it waits for a new key combination. Esc is the key name.
strings.en: Press the new key combination. Esc cancels.
strings.de: Neue Tastenkombination drücken. Esc bricht ab.

strings.context: Warning in the keyboard shortcuts dialog before a key is taken from another action. {key} is the key combination, {action} the name of the action that has it now.
strings.en: {key} is bound to {action}. Take it from there?

strings.context: Button in the keyboard shortcuts dialog that takes a key from the action that has it and gives it to the selected one.
Question in the keyboard shortcuts dialog before every action gets the keys the app ships with again.
strings.en: Give every action its built-in keys again?
strings.de: Allen Aktionen wieder ihre eingebauten Tasten geben?

strings.context: Button in the keyboard shortcuts dialog that gives the selected action the keys the app ships with again.
Button in the keyboard shortcuts dialog that gives every action the keys the app ships with again. Asks first.
Button in the keyboard shortcuts dialog that records a further key for the selected action.
Button in the keyboard shortcuts dialog that records a new key in place of the focused one.
Error in the keyboard shortcuts dialog when the pressed key has no name the config file can store, such as F13 or a media key.
strings.en: This key cannot be stored in the config.
strings.de: Diese Taste lässt sich nicht in der Konfiguration speichern.

strings.context: Error in the keyboard shortcuts dialog when a plain letter or digit is pressed: alone it jumps to a file name (type-ahead). Ctrl, Alt and Cmd are key names.
strings.en: Letters and digits need Ctrl, Alt or Cmd: alone they jump to a file name.
strings.de: Buchstaben und Ziffern brauchen Ctrl, Alt oder Cmd: allein springen sie zu einem Dateinamen.

strings.context: Error in the keyboard shortcuts dialog: Escape cannot be bound because it closes dialogs and stops jobs.
strings.en: Esc is reserved: it closes dialogs and stops jobs.
strings.de: Esc ist vergeben: Es schließt Dialoge und stoppt Aufträge.

strings.context: Error in the keyboard shortcuts dialog: the search view handles this key itself, so a search action cannot take it.
strings.en: The search view uses this key itself.
strings.de: Die Suche nutzt diese Taste selbst.

strings.context: Error in the keyboard shortcuts dialog when an action already has the most keys allowed. {count} is that number.
strings.en: An action takes at most {count} keys.

strings.context: Notice in the keyboard shortcuts dialog when the pressed key is already one of the selected action's keys. {key} is the key combination.
strings.en: {key} is already a key of this action.
strings.de: {key} ist schon eine Taste dieser Aktion.

strings.context: Error in the keyboard shortcuts dialog when the change could not be saved to the config file. {reason} is the explanation.
Verb next to the Backspace key in the footer hints of the keyboard shortcuts dialog: removes the focused key. One word.
Verb next to the Shift+Backspace key in the footer hints of the keyboard shortcuts dialog: gives the action its built-in keys again. One word.

Entry of the command palette and the menu bar that runs the key action grant_folder_access, which opens the system folder dialog so the user can allow the App Store version to open another folder or drive. The plain name of what the action does, as short as a menu entry; it has no key. The ellipsis says a dialog follows. Listed only in the App Store version.

Entry of the command list that runs the key action open_privacy_settings, which opens the Full Disk Access page of macOS System Settings so the app may read protected folders. The plain name of what the action does, as short as a menu entry; it has no key. Listed only on a Mac outside the App Store version.
Title of the dialog shown at the start of the App Store version while the home folder cannot be opened. The app runs in the macOS App Sandbox and may open only folders the user allows.

Explanation in the dialog that asks the user to allow access to the home folder. macOS lets the App Store version open only the folders the user chooses in a system dialog; one choice of the home folder covers everything below it. Drives and network volumes need a choice of their own.
strings.en: ncrs from the App Store runs in the macOS sandbox and can only open folders you allow. Choose your home folder to browse all of it. A drive or another volume needs its own choice.
strings.de: ncrs aus dem App Store läuft in der macOS-Sandbox und kann nur Ordner öffnen, die du freigibst. Wähle deinen Home-Ordner, um alles darin zu durchsuchen. Ein Laufwerk oder ein anderes Volume braucht eine eigene Freigabe.

strings.context: Second paragraph of the dialog that asks for access to the home folder: the choice is kept, and the command of the command palette adds more folders later. It names the command by its label.
strings.en: Your choice is remembered. Later, "Grant folder access…" in the command list adds more folders.
strings.de: Deine Wahl wird gemerkt. Später fügt „Ordner freigeben…“ in der Befehlsliste weitere Ordner hinzu.

strings.context: Button of the dialog that asks for access to the home folder: closes it without granting anything. The dialog comes back at the next start. One word.
Button of the dialog that asks for access to the home folder: opens the system folder dialog, in the home folder, to choose the folder to allow. The ellipsis says a dialog follows.
Notice in the status bar when the key action grant_folder_access runs outside the App Store version, which needs no folder grants because it can open every folder.
strings.en: Granting folders is only needed in the App Store version
strings.de: Ordner freigeben braucht nur die App-Store-Fassung

strings.context: Notice in the status bar after the user allowed a folder in the App Store version and the choice was saved. Takes the folder.
Reason in the status bar, put in place of the reason of grant.failed, when the access to a folder cannot be saved because the app has no data folder to keep it in.
strings.en: there is no data folder to keep it in
strings.de: es gibt keinen Datenordner, in dem er bleiben könnte

strings.context: Error in the status bar when the access the user allowed to a folder could not be saved, so it would be lost at the next start. Takes the folder and the reason, which stays untranslated.
strings.en: Could not save the access to {folder}: {reason}
strings.de: Der Zugriff auf {folder} konnte nicht gespeichert werden: {reason}

strings.context: Error in the connect dialog when the host key a server offers differs from the one recorded earlier for the same host and key type. The login is refused before any password is sent, because this can be an attack. Takes the host, the file that holds the old key and its line number. There is no button to trust the new key.
strings.en: The host key of {host} has changed ({file}, line {line}). Refused: this can be an attack. If the change is expected, remove the old entry.
strings.de: Der Hostschlüssel von {host} hat sich geändert ({file}, Zeile {line}). Abgelehnt: das kann ein Angriff sein. Ist die Änderung erwartet, den alten Eintrag entfernen.

strings.context: Error in the connect dialog when the host key of a server is marked as revoked in a known_hosts file. Takes the host.
strings.en: The host key of {host} is marked as revoked
strings.de: Der Hostschlüssel von {host} ist als widerrufen markiert

strings.context: Error in the connect dialog when a server offers a host key of another type than the one on record for it in a known_hosts file (an ed25519 key was recorded, and now an ECDSA key comes). Treated like a changed key: refused before any password is sent, no button to trust it. Takes the host, the file that holds the old key and its line number.
strings.en: {host} offers a different key type than the one on record ({file}, line {line}). Refused: this can be an attack.
strings.de: {host} bietet einen anderen Schlüsseltyp als den eingetragenen ({file}, Zeile {line}). Abgelehnt: das kann ein Angriff sein.

strings.context: Error in the connect dialog when a file with known host keys exists but cannot be read (permissions, or the App Store version before the home folder was allowed). The server cannot be checked, so there is no button to trust it. Takes the file and the system's reason, which stays untranslated.
strings.en: {file} could not be read, so the server cannot be checked: {reason}
strings.de: {file} ist nicht lesbar, der Server lässt sich daher nicht prüfen: {reason}

strings.context: Error in the connect dialog when the server does not accept a password at all, for example because it allows only key or keyboard-interactive login. Takes the host.
Error in the connect dialog when the server did not accept the user name and password.
strings.en: User name or password is wrong

strings.context: Error in the connect dialog when the server would accept a key file, but the key file is protected by a passphrase and none was given or kept. Takes the path of the key file.
strings.en: The key file {file} is protected by a passphrase
strings.de: Die Schlüsseldatei {file} ist durch eine Passphrase geschützt

strings.context: Error in the connect dialog when the passphrase typed for a key file does not open it. Takes the path of the key file.
strings.en: The passphrase does not open the key file {file}
strings.de: Die Passphrase öffnet die Schlüsseldatei {file} nicht

strings.context: Error when a server did not answer in time, in the connect dialog and in the status bar of a panel. Takes the host.
Error in the connect dialog when no connection to the server could be made. Takes the host and the technical reason, which stays untranslated.
Error in the connect dialog when the server offers no host key type that ncrs supports. Servers that offer only RSA host keys cannot be used yet. Takes the host.
strings.en: {host} offers no key type ncrs supports (RSA-only servers are not supported yet)
strings.de: {host} bietet keinen Schlüsseltyp, den ncrs kann (reine RSA-Server noch nicht unterstützt)

strings.context: Status bar notice of a panel that shows a folder on a server whose connection is gone. Opening the folder again connects anew. Takes the server as user@host.
strings.en: Connection to {server} lost. Open the folder again to reconnect.
strings.de: Verbindung zu {server} getrennt. Ordner erneut öffnen verbindet neu.

strings.context: Status bar notice of a panel when the server refused to list a folder or a request failed. Takes the server's message, which stays untranslated.
Error when an address typed into the path field starts with sftp:// but cannot be understood, for example because the port is not a number or a password is part of it.
Error in the connect dialog when the keychain could not be read or written while a saved password was looked up or stored. Takes the system's reason.
strings.en: The keychain could not be used: {reason}

strings.context: Error when a file name sent by a server could not be created on this computer, for example because it contains a path separator. The whole copy is stopped and nothing is left behind. Takes the name.
strings.en: The name {name} from the server cannot be created here
strings.de: Der Name {name} vom Server lässt sich hier nicht anlegen

strings.context: Entry of the command palette and the menu bar that runs the key action connect_server, which opens the dialog to connect to an SFTP server. The plain name of what the action does, as short as a menu entry; it has no key. The ellipsis says a dialog follows.

Theme name of the key action connect_server, shown dimmed after its plain name action.connect_server in the command palette, and matched when typing. A playful name (the delivery ship in Futurama); the plain name beside it says what the action does.

Entry of the command palette and the menu bar that runs the key action disconnect_server, which closes the connection to the server the active panel shows. The plain name of what the action does, as short as a menu entry; it has no key.

Theme name of the key action disconnect_server, shown dimmed after its plain name action.disconnect_server in the command palette, and matched when typing. A playful name; the plain name beside it says what the action does.
Title of the dialog in which the user connects to an SFTP server: host, port, user name and password.
Label and placeholder of the field for the host name or address of the server in the connect dialog.
Label and placeholder of the field for the port of the server in the connect dialog. Left empty, it means 22.
Label and placeholder of the field for the user name on the server in the connect dialog.
Label and placeholder of the password field in the connect dialog. The text typed there is hidden. Optional: the ssh agent and key files are tried first.
Label of the checkbox in the connect dialog that stores the password in the system keychain, one entry per server, so the next connection asks for nothing.
Label of the checkbox in the connect dialog that adds the server to the list of saved servers in the config file. The password is never written there.
Label and placeholder of the optional field in the connect dialog for the folder on the server to open first. Left empty, the home folder of the login opens.
Label of the optional field in the connect dialog for a key file (an ssh private key) to log in with instead of a password. Left empty, ncrs tries the ssh agent and the keys of ~/.ssh by itself.

Placeholder of the empty key file field in the connect dialog. Says what ncrs tries without being told: the ssh agent, the entries of ~/.ssh/config and the default key files such as ~/.ssh/id_ed25519. Keep ~/.ssh/config and id_ed25519 as they are.
strings.en: Found by itself: ssh agent, ~/.ssh/config, id_ed25519 …

strings.context: Button next to the key file field in the connect dialog; opens the system dialog to pick the key file. The trailing dots show that a dialog follows.

Dimmed line under the key file field in the connect dialog of the App Store version only. The sandbox of that version blocks the ssh agent, so the key file has to be chosen by hand. The field is empty there, since nothing is found by itself.
strings.en: The App Store version cannot use the ssh agent. Choose the key file here.
strings.de: Die App-Store-Version kann den ssh-Agent nicht nutzen. Schlüsseldatei hier wählen.

strings.context: Dimmed line under host and port in the connect dialog when ~/.ssh/config has an entry for the typed host name. Takes the details {details}, a comma-separated list of the host name, the port and the user from remote.ssh_config_port and remote.ssh_config_user. Keep ~/.ssh/config as it is.
Part of the line remote.ssh_config: the port the ssh config gives for the host. Takes the port number.
Part of the line remote.ssh_config: the user name the ssh config gives for the host. Takes the user name.
Title of the dialog stage that asks for the passphrase of a key file. A passphrase is the password that protects an ssh private key.
Text of the dialog stage that asks for the passphrase of a key file. Takes the path of the key file, with ~ for the home folder.
strings.en: {key} is locked. The server asks for this key.
strings.de: {key} ist gesperrt. Der Server verlangt diesen Schlüssel.
