strings.context: Label of the checkbox in the passphrase stage of the connect dialog that stores the passphrase in the system keychain, so the key opens without asking next time.
Button of the passphrase stage of the connect dialog: opens the key file with the typed passphrase and connects. Verb, one word.
Error line in the passphrase stage of the connect dialog when the typed passphrase does not open the key file.
strings.en: That passphrase did not unlock the key.
strings.de: Diese Passphrase hat den Schlüssel nicht entsperrt.

strings.context: Button of the connect dialog that connects to the server. Verb, one word.
Dimmed line in the connect dialog while the connection is being made.
Title of the dialog stage that asks whether to trust a server ncrs has not seen before. Nothing has been sent to the server at that point, no password.

Text of the dialog stage that asks whether to trust an unknown server. Takes the host and the SHA256 fingerprint of its host key; the user compares it with the one the administrator of the server gives.
strings.en: {host} is not known yet. Compare the fingerprint with the one the server's administrator gives you: {fingerprint}
strings.de: {host} ist noch unbekannt. Fingerabdruck mit dem vom Server-Admin genannten vergleichen: {fingerprint}

strings.context: Extra line in the dialog stage that asks whether to trust an unknown server, shown when a known_hosts file lists a certificate authority for this server. ncrs does not check host certificates, so the server is asked about like any other.
strings.en: A known_hosts file lists a certificate authority for this server. ncrs does not check host certificates, so the fingerprint has to be compared.
strings.de: Eine known_hosts-Datei nennt für diesen Server eine Zertifizierungsstelle. ncrs prüft keine Host-Zertifikate, der Fingerabdruck muss deshalb verglichen werden.

strings.context: Button of the dialog stage that asks whether to trust an unknown server: remembers its host key and connects. Several words.
Status bar notice when a key or command that would change something on a server is used in a panel that shows one: only browsing, viewing and copying work there for now.
strings.en: Files on the server can only be browsed, viewed and copied for now.
strings.de: Dateien auf dem Server lassen sich vorerst nur ansehen und kopieren.

strings.context: Status bar notice when the command line is used while the active panel shows a server: commands run on this computer only, not on the server.
strings.en: The command line does not run on a server
strings.de: Die Kommandozeile läuft nicht auf einem Server

strings.context: Notice in the status bar after the connection to a server was made. Takes the server as user@host.
Notice in the status bar after the user closed the connection to a server. Takes the server as user@host.
Notice in the status bar when the key action disconnect_server runs while the active panel does not show a server.
strings.en: This panel is not on a server

strings.context: Heading of the part of the drive menu that lists servers: the saved ones and those connected now.
Marker after a server in the drive menu whose connection is open at the moment. One word.
Verb next to the Backspace or Del key in the footer of the drive menu while a connected server is highlighted: closes its connection. One word, like volumes.hint_remove_favourite.
Error in the copy and move dialog when a move is asked to or from an SFTP server. Moving would delete the source, which is not offered across a server for now; copying is.
strings.en: Moving to or from a server is not supported; copy instead
strings.de: Verschieben auf/von einem Server geht nicht; stattdessen kopieren

strings.context: Error in the copy and move dialog when the source and the target are both on SFTP servers. Copying has to go through this computer, which is not offered for now.
strings.en: Copying between servers is not supported

strings.context: Status bar error when the view key is pressed on a file on an SFTP server but ncrs has no folder for the temporary copy: the cache folder could not be created or the system names none. Nothing was fetched.
strings.en: No folder for temporary copies, so this file cannot be viewed from the server. Copy it out instead.
strings.de: Kein Ordner für temporäre Kopien, die Datei lässt sich daher nicht vom Server ansehen. Stattdessen herauskopieren.

strings.context: Like error.remote_view_unavailable, when the system also said why the folder for temporary copies could not be opened. Takes the reason, already in the user's language.
strings.en: No folder for temporary copies ({reason}), so this file cannot be viewed from the server. Copy it out instead.
strings.de: Kein Ordner für temporäre Kopien ({reason}), die Datei lässt sich daher nicht vom Server ansehen. Stattdessen herauskopieren.

strings.context: Like error.archive_view_unavailable, when the system also said why the folder for temporary copies could not be opened. Takes the reason, already in the user's language.
strings.en: No folder for temporary copies ({reason}), so this file cannot be viewed from the archive. Copy it out instead.
strings.de: Kein Ordner für temporäre Kopien ({reason}), die Datei lässt sich daher nicht aus dem Archiv ansehen. Stattdessen herauskopieren.

strings.context: Status bar error when the view key is pressed on a file on an SFTP server that could run (script, app, shortcut) and no editor program is set to show it in. Takes the file name. No key names: the edit key is refused on a server, so it must not be suggested.
strings.en: {name} could be executed, ncrs does not view it from a server
strings.de: {name} könnte ausgeführt werden und wird nicht vom Server angezeigt

strings.context: Entry of the feature list on the settings tab: the saved SFTP servers.
Line under the heading of the servers page on the settings tab. The servers are saved in the config file without their passwords; a password is kept in the keychain only if the user asked for it.
strings.en: SFTP servers you can open from the drive menu. Passwords stay in the keychain, never in the config.
strings.de: SFTP-Server, die sich im Laufwerksmenü öffnen lassen. Passwörter bleiben im Schlüsselbund, nie in der Konfiguration.

strings.context: Label of the row on the servers page of the settings tab that adds a server. Its button opens the connect dialog with the box that saves the server ticked. The ellipsis says a dialog follows.
Button on the servers page of the settings tab, in the row that adds a server: opens the connect dialog. Short, like the other buttons of the page.
Button on the servers page of the settings tab that removes a saved server from the list. It also forgets the password the keychain holds for it.
Row on the servers page of the settings tab while no server is saved.

Entry of the command list and the app menu on a Mac that runs the key action about, which opens the card with the version, the licence and the third-party licences of the app. The name of what the action does, as short as a menu entry; it has no key.

Theme name of the key action about, shown dimmed after its plain name action.about in the command list, and matched when typing. A playful name (the crew of the delivery ship, in the Futurama theme of the app); the plain name beside it says what the action does.
Title of the card that shows the version, the licence and the third-party licences of the app.
Playful theme name shown dimmed next to the title of the about card, in the Futurama theme of the app: the crew roster of the Planet Express ship.
Line of the about card with the version of the app. {version} is the version number, like 1.2.3.
Line of the about card that names the licence ncrs itself is under.
Button of the about card that opens the project page of ncrs in the browser. One word.
Button of the about card that opens the file with the licences of the libraries ncrs is built from.
Button of the about card that closes it. One word, verb.
Line of the about card shown when the file with the third-party licences is not part of this copy of ncrs, for example a build from source. {url} is the web address where the same file can be read.
strings.en: The licence file is not part of this build. Read it online: {url}
strings.de: Die Lizenzdatei gehört nicht zu diesem Build. Online lesen: {url}

strings.context: Line of the Updates page of the settings tab shown when the update check found a newer release of ncrs. {version} is the version number of that release, like 1.3.0. Keep the placeholder verbatim.
Label of a row of the Updates page of the settings tab: the value beside it is the version of ncrs that is running, like 1.2.0, or 1.2.0 (568c38e) for a development build.
Dim line at the bottom of the Updates page of the settings tab while the update check is on and knows of no newer release of ncrs.
strings.de: ncrs ist auf dem neuesten Stand.

strings.context: Dim line at the bottom of the Updates page of the settings tab while the update check is on and the last check of the newest release of ncrs did not get an answer, for example because there is no network. The app tries again later by itself.
strings.en: The last check for updates failed. ncrs tries again later.
strings.de: Die letzte Suche nach Updates ist fehlgeschlagen. ncrs versucht es später erneut.

strings.context: Dim line at the bottom of the Updates page of the settings tab while the update check is on but no check has finished yet, for example right after the start. Shown instead of the statement that ncrs is up to date.
strings.en: No check for updates has finished yet.
strings.de: Noch keine Suche nach Updates abgeschlossen.

strings.context: Dim line at the bottom of the Updates page of the settings tab while the update check is on, for a copy that checked for updates before the app remembered how the check ended. {date} is the day of that check, like 2026-11-18. Shown instead of the statement that ncrs is up to date.
Button of the Updates page of the settings tab, in the row that names a newer release. Opens the web page with the release notes of that version in the browser.
Button of the Updates page of the settings tab, in the row that names a newer release. Hides the notice about exactly this version; a still newer version is announced again.

Label of a row of the Updates page of the settings tab for a copy of ncrs installed through a package manager (apt, dnf, zypper, Homebrew). The field beside it holds the command the user runs in a terminal to update; ends with a colon.

Hermes overview (the first page of the Hermes card, the one place for non-technical users). Line under the filing box of the flow picture: the filing location and how the documents are sorted into it. {path} is a folder, {pattern} the way the documents are sorted.
Hermes overview (the first page of the Hermes card, the one place for non-technical users). Dimmed word after the protection heading when the index is encrypted.
Hermes overview (the first page of the Hermes card, the one place for non-technical users). Dimmed word after the protection heading when the index is not encrypted.
Hermes overview (the first page of the Hermes card, the one place for non-technical users). Sentence in the protection section on macOS when the index is encrypted.
strings.en: The index is stored encrypted on this Mac, the key in the keychain. Your files themselves stay unchanged.
strings.de: Der Index liegt verschlüsselt auf diesem Mac, der Schlüssel im Schlüsselbund. Deine Dateien selbst bleiben unverändert.

strings.context: Hermes overview (the first page of the Hermes card, the one place for non-technical users). Sentence in the protection section on other systems than macOS when the index is encrypted.
strings.en: The index is stored encrypted on this computer, the key in the system's credential store. Your files themselves stay unchanged.
strings.de: Der Index liegt verschlüsselt auf diesem Computer, der Schlüssel im Schlüsselspeicher des Systems. Deine Dateien selbst bleiben unverändert.

strings.context: Hermes overview (the first page of the Hermes card, the one place for non-technical users). Sentence in the protection section on macOS when the index is not encrypted.
strings.en: The index is stored unencrypted on this Mac. Your files themselves stay unchanged.
strings.de: Der Index liegt unverschlüsselt auf diesem Mac. Deine Dateien selbst bleiben unverändert.

strings.context: Hermes overview (the first page of the Hermes card, the one place for non-technical users). Sentence in the protection section on other systems than macOS when the index is not encrypted.
strings.en: The index is stored unencrypted on this computer. Your files themselves stay unchanged.
strings.de: Der Index liegt unverschlüsselt auf diesem Computer. Deine Dateien selbst bleiben unverändert.

strings.context: Hermes overview (the first page of the Hermes card, the one place for non-technical users). Sentence in the protection section when Hermes has no index yet.
strings.en: Hermes has no index yet. It is created when Hermes starts.
strings.de: Hermes hat noch keinen Index. Er entsteht, sobald Hermes startet.

strings.context: Hermes overview (the first page of the Hermes card, the one place for non-technical users). Sentence in the protection section on macOS when the key of the encrypted index is not in the keychain.
strings.en: The key for the index is missing in the keychain.
strings.de: Der Schlüssel für den Index fehlt im Schlüsselbund.

strings.context: Hermes overview (the first page of the Hermes card, the one place for non-technical users). Sentence in the protection section on other systems than macOS when the key of the encrypted index is not in the credential store.
strings.en: The key for the index is missing in the system's credential store.
strings.de: Der Schlüssel für den Index fehlt im Schlüsselspeicher des Systems.

strings.context: Hermes overview (the first page of the Hermes card, the one place for non-technical users). Sentence in the protection section when the stored key does not open the encrypted index.
strings.en: The stored key does not fit the index.
strings.de: Der gespeicherte Schlüssel passt nicht zum Index.

strings.context: Hermes overview (the first page of the Hermes card, the one place for non-technical users). Button in the protection section that opens the card where the recovery key is typed in.
Hermes overview (the first page of the Hermes card, the one place for non-technical users). Button in the protection section that encrypts the index which is stored unencrypted.

Hermes overview (the first page of the Hermes card, the one place for non-technical users). Button in the protection section that opens the question whether to remove the index and begin again. The dots mean a question follows.
Hermes overview (the first page of the Hermes card, the one place for non-technical users). Word after the protection heading while the index is being encrypted.
Hermes overview (the first page of the Hermes card, the one place for non-technical users). Word after the protection heading while the index and its key are being removed.
Hermes overview (the first page of the Hermes card, the one place for non-technical users). Sentence in the protection section while the index is being encrypted or removed.
strings.en: Please wait a moment. Nothing is filed while this runs.
strings.de: Einen Moment bitte. Währenddessen wird nichts abgelegt.

strings.context: Hermes overview (the first page of the Hermes card, the one place for non-technical users). Sentence in the protection section when encrypting did not work; the index stays as it was. {reason} is the cause.
strings.en: The index could not be encrypted and stays as it was: {reason}
strings.de: Der Index konnte nicht verschlüsselt werden und bleibt, wie er war: {reason}

strings.context: Hermes overview (the first page of the Hermes card, the one place for non-technical users). Sentence in the protection section when removing the index did not work. {reason} is the cause.
strings.en: The index could not be removed: {reason}
strings.de: Der Index konnte nicht entfernt werden: {reason}

strings.context: Hermes overview (the first page of the Hermes card, the one place for non-technical users). Sentence in the protection section when the index was removed but its key stays in the key store. {reason} is the cause.
strings.en: The index was removed, but its key could not be deleted from the key store: {reason}
strings.de: Der Index wurde entfernt, aber sein Schlüssel ließ sich nicht aus dem Schlüsselspeicher löschen: {reason}

strings.context: Hermes overview (the first page of the Hermes card, the one place for non-technical users). Sentence in the protection section when the check on opening found damage in the index file. Nothing was changed; the index stays in use. {reason} is the technical finding of the check.
strings.en: The check on opening found damage in the index. Nothing was changed: {reason}
strings.de: Die Prüfung beim Öffnen hat Schäden im Index gefunden. Es wurde nichts verändert: {reason}

strings.context: Title of the question in the Hermes overview whether to remove the index and begin again.
Body of the question in the Hermes overview whether to start the index over: says that the index is set aside, not deleted, and what is in it. index.db.set-aside is the file name and stays as it is.
strings.en: The index is set aside, with its rules, rule suggestions, reports, the undo history, what ncrs knows about your documents and the entries waiting for review. It stays as index.db.set-aside in the data folder and can be brought back with the recovery key.
strings.de: Der Index wird zur Seite gelegt, mit seinen Regeln, Regelvorschlägen, Auswertungen, dem Rückgängig-Verlauf, dem Wissen von ncrs über deine Dokumente und den Einträgen, die auf Prüfung warten. Er bleibt als index.db.set-aside im Datenordner und lässt sich mit dem Wiederherstellungsschlüssel zurückholen.

strings.context: Body of the question in the Hermes overview whether to remove the index: says what stays.
strings.en: Your files and folders stay where they are. The key of the index is removed as well. Afterwards you set up Hermes again.
strings.de: Deine Dateien und Ordner bleiben, wo sie sind. Auch der Schlüssel des Index wird entfernt. Danach richtest du Hermes neu ein.

strings.context: Button of the question in the Hermes overview that sets the index aside and starts a new one. Destructive, red.
Body of the question in the Hermes overview whether to start the index over, for an index that is not encrypted: names what is lost. Without encryption there is no recovery key, so nothing is kept.
strings.en: This removes the index with its rules, rule suggestions, reports and the undo history. It also removes what ncrs knows about your documents and the entries waiting for review.
strings.de: Damit wird der Index entfernt, mit seinen Regeln, Regelvorschlägen, Auswertungen und dem Rückgängig-Verlauf. Auch das Wissen von ncrs über deine Dokumente und die Einträge, die auf Prüfung warten, gehen verloren.

strings.context: Button of the question in the Hermes overview that removes an index that is not encrypted. Destructive, red.
Hermes overview (the first page of the Hermes card, the one place for non-technical users). Button next to the sentence that says Hermes could not start.

First word of the file name that Paste gives a picture or text from the clipboard, followed by date and time and the ending: "Pasted 2026-10-28 08.15.txt". One word, no trailing space, no characters a file name cannot hold.

Entry of the command palette that runs the key action paste. It copies files from the clipboard into the active panel, or saves a picture as PNG or text as TXT there; the key bound to it is shown beside it.

Entry of the command palette that runs the key action copy_files. It puts the tagged files, or the one under the cursor, on the system clipboard as files, so Finder or Explorer can paste them; the key bound to it, if any, is shown beside it.
Status bar notice after Paste when the system clipboard holds no files, no picture and no text, or cannot be read.
strings.en: The clipboard holds no files, image or text.
strings.de: Die Zwischenablage enthält keine Dateien, kein Bild und keinen Text.

strings.context: Status bar confirmation after the user put one file or folder on the system clipboard as a file. Past participle, short.
Status bar confirmation after the user put several files or folders on the system clipboard as files. Takes the count, which is always two or more.

Status bar notice when "Copy files to the clipboard" is used on entries inside an archive or on an SFTP server. Only files on the local disk can go on the system clipboard as files; nothing was copied.
strings.en: Only files on this computer's disk can be copied to the clipboard. Copy them to a folder first.
strings.de: Nur Dateien von der Platte dieses Computers lassen sich in die Zwischenablage kopieren. Kopiere sie zuerst in einen Ordner.

strings.context: Status bar error when the system clipboard refused the files. Takes the reason the system gave.
strings.en: Could not copy the files to the clipboard: {reason}
strings.de: Die Dateien konnten nicht in die Zwischenablage kopiert werden: {reason}

strings.context: Status bar notice when files are dragged out of the window while the selection is inside an archive or on an SFTP server. Only files on the local disk can be dragged out; nothing was dragged.
strings.en: Only files on this computer's disk can be dragged out of ncrs. Copy them to a folder first.
strings.de: Nur Dateien von der Platte dieses Computers lassen sich aus ncrs herausziehen. Kopiere sie zuerst in einen Ordner.

strings.context: Status bar error when the system refused to start dragging files out of the window. Takes the reason the system gave.
strings.en: Could not drag the files out of ncrs: {reason}
strings.de: Die Dateien konnten nicht aus ncrs herausgezogen werden: {reason}

strings.context: Title of the dialog that asks for the file name when a picture or text from the clipboard is pasted into a folder.
Confirm button of the dialog that names the file a pasted picture or text is saved as. Verb.
Status bar notice when Paste is used while a copy or another job is running or a dialog is open. Nothing is pasted; the user can paste again later.
strings.en: Paste again when the running job or dialog is done
strings.de: Erneut einfügen, wenn der laufende Auftrag oder Dialog fertig ist

strings.context: Status bar while entries are being put back from the trash. Same shape as job.delete.
Command that shows the trash in place of a panel, listing what can be put back. Plain name.
Theme name of the key action trash, shown dimmed after its plain name action.trash in the command palette, and matched when typing. Matches the garbage ball of action.delete.theme.
Command that puts back what the latest delete (F8) of this session moved to the trash. Plain name.
Theme name of the key action restore_last_deletion, shown dimmed after its plain name in the command palette, and matched when typing. Plays on action.delete.theme, the garbage ball.
Command that takes back the latest batch rename (the rename of several tagged entries at once). Plain name. Only offered while there is a batch to take back.
Batch rename dialog. Title; {count} is how many entries are renamed, always 2 or more.
Batch rename dialog. Label of the field that holds the pattern for the new names.
Batch rename dialog. Label of the row of buttons that insert a part into the pattern (name, counter, date, extension).
Batch rename dialog. Label of the row of buttons that insert a field Hermes read from the document (sender, date, kind, amount).
Batch rename dialog. Button that inserts the old name of the entry into the pattern.
Batch rename dialog. Button that inserts the first characters of the old name into the pattern.
Batch rename dialog. Button that inserts a running number into the pattern.
Batch rename dialog. Button that inserts the date the file was last changed into the pattern.
Batch rename dialog. Button that inserts the date a photo was taken into the pattern; the modified date stands in when the file has none.
Batch rename dialog. Button that inserts the file extension, with its dot, into the pattern.
Batch rename dialog. Button that inserts the sender of the document, as Hermes read it, into the pattern.
Batch rename dialog. Button that inserts the date printed on the document into the pattern.
Batch rename dialog. Button that inserts the kind of the document (invoice, contract) into the pattern.
Batch rename dialog. Button that inserts the amount of the document into the pattern.
Batch rename dialog. Label above the field for the number the counter starts at.
Batch rename dialog. Label above the field for how many digits the counter is padded to with zeros.
Batch rename dialog. Label above the field for the text to look for in the new names.
Batch rename dialog. Label above the field for the text that replaces what Find matched.
Batch rename dialog. Label above the choice of upper and lower case for the new names.
Batch rename dialog. Choice: leave upper and lower case as they are.
Batch rename dialog. Choice: make the new names lower case.
Batch rename dialog. Choice: make the new names upper case.
Batch rename dialog. Checkbox: Find is a regular expression.
Batch rename dialog. Header of the preview column with the current names.
Batch rename dialog. Header of the preview column with the names the pattern gives.
Batch rename dialog. Header of the preview column that says what is wrong with a name.
Batch rename dialog. Shown under the preview while names clash or are not allowed; {count} is how many rows have a problem. The Rename button stays off until they are fixed.
strings.en: {count} names clash. Change the pattern to go on.
strings.de: {count} Namen kollidieren. Ändere das Muster, um fortzufahren.

strings.context: Batch rename dialog. Shown under the preview when Find is not a valid regular expression. {reason} is the parser's message.
Batch rename dialog. What Hermes thinks the names of this folder follow. {pattern} is a pattern with tokens in braces; keep it unchanged.

Batch rename dialog. Shown instead of a name proposal when the AI server is on another computer and the user has not allowed sending folders and file names. Points to the setting; do not name a button.
strings.en: Hermes did not look at this folder: sending folders and file names to the server is not allowed (Settings, AI).
strings.de: Hermes hat diesen Ordner nicht angesehen: Ordner und Dateinamen an den Server zu senden ist nicht freigegeben (Einstellungen, KI).

strings.context: Batch rename dialog. Button that puts the pattern Hermes proposes into the field.
Batch rename dialog. Button that renames the entries.
Batch rename dialog. Problem of a row whose new name is already given to an earlier row; {n} is that row's line number.
Batch rename dialog. Problem of a row whose new name belongs to another entry of the folder.
strings.de: Gibt es schon in diesem Ordner

strings.context: Batch rename dialog. Problem of a row whose pattern uses a field that is not known for it; {field} is the field's name from the field_* strings.
Batch rename dialog. Name of the modified date, filled into problem_missing.
Batch rename dialog. Name of the sender, filled into problem_missing.
Batch rename dialog. Name of the document date, filled into problem_missing.
Batch rename dialog. Name of the document kind, filled into problem_missing.
Batch rename dialog. Name of the amount, filled into problem_missing.
Notice after a batch rename. {count} is how many entries were renamed. The command list has Undo rename, which takes it back.
strings.en: {count} entries renamed. To take it back, use Undo rename in the command list.
strings.de: {count} Einträge umbenannt. Zum Zurücknehmen: Umbenennen zurücknehmen in der Befehlsliste.

strings.context: Notice after Undo rename took the names of the last batch back. {count} is how many entries.
strings.en: {count} entries have their old names back.
strings.de: {count} Einträge haben ihre alten Namen zurück.

strings.context: Error when a batch rename stopped. {name} is the entry that failed, {reason} the system's reason. Everything renamed before it was put back.
strings.en: Could not rename {name}: {reason}. Nothing was changed.
strings.de: {name} konnte nicht umbenannt werden: {reason}. Es wurde nichts geändert.

strings.context: Error when a batch rename stopped and the names changed before it could not all be put back. {name} is the entry that failed, {reason} the system's reason.
strings.en: Could not rename {name}: {reason}. Some entries keep their new names.
strings.de: {name} konnte nicht umbenannt werden: {reason}. Einige Einträge behalten ihre neuen Namen.

strings.context: Error when a batch rename was aborted and the names changed so far could not all be put back. {name} is the entry the rename was about to change.
strings.en: Stopped before {name}, but some entries keep their new names.
strings.de: Vor {name} abgebrochen, aber einige Einträge behalten ihre neuen Namen.

strings.context: Error of Undo rename when an entry of the batch has been moved or deleted since. {name} is its name. Nothing is changed.
strings.de: {name} gibt es nicht mehr. Es wurde nichts geändert.

strings.context: Error of Undo rename when the old name of an entry belongs to another entry now. {name} is the old name. Nothing is changed.
strings.en: {name} is taken by another entry. Nothing was changed.
strings.de: {name} ist von einem anderen Eintrag belegt. Es wurde nichts geändert.

strings.context: Command that opens the system trash in the Finder (macOS only). Plain name.
strings.en: Open the trash in the Finder

strings.context: Name of the trash view, shown in the title bar tab, above the list and in the drive menu, when the whole system trash can be listed (Windows, Linux). The count of entries is appended in brackets.

Name of the trash view on macOS, which can only list what ncrs moved to the trash itself. Shown in the title bar tab, above the list and in the drive menu. The count of entries is appended in brackets.
Column heading of the trash view: the name of the entry.
Column heading of the trash view: the folder the entry was in before it was deleted.
Column heading of the trash view: when the entry was deleted.
Text of the trash view when the system trash holds nothing.
Text of the trash view on macOS when ncrs has not moved anything to the trash that is still there.
strings.de: In ncrs wurde noch nichts gelöscht.

strings.context: Text of the trash view while the entries are being read.
Text of the trash view when the entries could not be read. Takes {reason}.
strings.en: The trash could not be read: {reason}

strings.de: Nur, was ncrs in den Papierkorb gelegt hat. Den Rest zeigt der Papierkorb im Finder ({key}).

strings.en: Only what ncrs moved to the trash. Open the trash in the Finder for the rest.
strings.de: Nur, was ncrs in den Papierkorb gelegt hat. Den Rest zeigt der Papierkorb im Finder.

strings.de: {name} kann hier nicht wiederhergestellt werden: ncrs hat keinen Zugriff auf den Ordner. Klicken, um den Papierkorb im Finder zu öffnen

strings.context: Status bar error, pressable, on macOS when an entry could not be put back. Takes {name} and {reason}. The press opens the trash in the Finder.

strings.de: {name} konnte nicht wiederhergestellt werden, klicken öffnet den Papierkorb im Finder: {reason}

strings.context: Status bar notice after F8 moved entries to the trash. Takes {count} and {key}, the key that puts them back.
strings.en: Moved {count} to the trash. {key} puts it back.
strings.de: {count} in den Papierkorb verschoben. Mit {key} kommt es zurück.

strings.context: Same as trash.moved_with_key, for when the command has no key. Takes {count}.

strings.de: Der Finder konnte nicht geöffnet werden: {reason}

strings.context: Kind of a condition: the document text contains the value.
Kind of a condition: the document text contains the value as a whole word.
Kind of a condition: the document text matches a regular expression.
Kind of a condition: the sender of the document is the value.
Kind of a condition: the address of the sender is the value.
Kind of a condition: the document names this IBAN.
Kind of a condition: the document names this tax number.
Kind of a condition: the address block of the document names this recipient.
Kind of a condition: the document lies in this folder.
Line of the condition editor when the list has no condition yet.
Choice in the condition editor: one condition is enough. Continues the label Matches when.
Choice in the condition editor: every condition must hold. Continues the label Matches when.
Button of the condition editor: adds an empty condition to the list.
Error line under a condition in the condition editor when its value is empty and the user tried to save.
Error line under a condition of the kind regular expression whose value cannot be compiled. Takes the reason, which stays in English.

strings.de: Keine gültige IBAN: die Prüfziffern stimmen nicht.

strings.context: Entry of the command list and the menu that runs the key action rules, which opens the settings on the page of the sorting: targets, rules and sources. The plain name of what the action does, as short as a menu entry; the key bound to it is shown beside it.

Theme name of the key action rules, shown dimmed after its plain name action.rules in the command list, and matched when typing. A playful name (Hermes is a bureaucrat, and rules are his regulations); the plain name beside it says what the action does.
Start of a rule sentence on the rules page. Takes the conditions of the rule, joined, and what the rule does with a matching document after the arrow.

One tag a rule sets, inside the rule sentence on the rules page (also in the question before a rule is deleted). {tag} is the tag as the user wrote it; the quotes are the quotation marks of the language.
Word between two conditions of a rule sentence when the rule needs all of them. Shown with a space on either side.
Word between two conditions of a rule sentence when the rule needs only one of them. Shown with a space on either side.
Condition in a rule sentence on the rules page: the rule asks for a piece of text. Takes the value. Reads after “If” or after “and” / “or”.
Condition in a rule sentence on the rules page: the rule asks that a piece of text is not there. Takes the value. Reads after “If” or after “and” / “or”.
Condition in a rule sentence on the rules page: the rule asks for a whole word. Takes the value. Reads after “If” or after “and” / “or”.
Condition in a rule sentence on the rules page: the rule asks that a whole word is not there. Takes the value. Reads after “If” or after “and” / “or”.
strings.en: the text does not contain the word “{value}”
strings.de: der Text das Wort „{value}“ nicht enthält

strings.context: Condition in a rule sentence on the rules page: the rule asks for a regular expression, written between slashes. Takes the value. Reads after “If” or after “and” / “or”.
Condition in a rule sentence on the rules page: the rule asks that a regular expression, written between slashes is not there. Takes the value. Reads after “If” or after “and” / “or”.
Condition in a rule sentence on the rules page: the rule asks for the sender name. Takes the value. Reads after “If” or after “and” / “or”.
Condition in a rule sentence on the rules page: the rule asks that the sender name is not there. Takes the value. Reads after “If” or after “and” / “or”.
Condition in a rule sentence on the rules page: the rule asks for the address of the sender. Takes the value. Reads after “If” or after “and” / “or”.
Condition in a rule sentence on the rules page: the rule asks that the address of the sender is not there. Takes the value. Reads after “If” or after “and” / “or”.
Condition in a rule sentence on the rules page: the rule asks for a bank account number. Takes the value. Reads after “If” or after “and” / “or”.
Condition in a rule sentence on the rules page: the rule asks that a bank account number is not there. Takes the value. Reads after “If” or after “and” / “or”.
strings.en: the text does not contain the IBAN “{value}”
strings.de: der Text die IBAN „{value}“ nicht enthält

strings.context: Condition in a rule sentence on the rules page: the rule asks for a tax identification number. Takes the value. Reads after “If” or after “and” / “or”.
strings.en: the text contains the tax ID “{value}”

strings.context: Condition in a rule sentence on the rules page: the rule asks that a tax identification number is not there. Takes the value. Reads after “If” or after “and” / “or”.
strings.en: the text does not contain the tax ID “{value}”
strings.de: der Text die Steuer-ID „{value}“ nicht enthält

strings.context: Condition in a rule sentence on the rules page: the rule asks for the recipient name. Takes the value. Reads after “If” or after “and” / “or”.
Condition in a rule sentence on the rules page: the rule asks that the recipient name is not there. Takes the value. Reads after “If” or after “and” / “or”.
Condition in a rule sentence on the rules page: the rule asks for the folder the document lies in. Takes the value. Reads after “If” or after “and” / “or”.
Condition in a rule sentence on the rules page: the rule asks that the folder the document lies in is not there. Takes the value. Reads after “If” or after “and” / “or”.
strings.en: the document does not lie in “{value}”

strings.context: Condition in a rule sentence on the rules page: the rule asks that the document comes from one source. Takes the name of the source. Reads after “If” or after “and” / “or”.
strings.en: the document comes from the source “{value}”
strings.de: das Dokument aus der Quelle „{value}“ stammt

strings.context: Condition in a rule sentence on the rules page: the rule asks that the document does not come from one source. Takes the name of the source. Reads after “If” or after “and” / “or”.
strings.en: the document does not come from the source “{value}”
strings.de: das Dokument nicht aus der Quelle „{value}“ stammt

strings.context: Hits of a rule on the rules page when exactly one document was filed by it; the number is 1.
Hits of a rule on the rules page when none or several documents were filed by it. Takes the number.
Button in the delete question of the rules page: keeps the rule.
Button in the remove question of the rules page: removes the rule. Also the title of that dialog.
Question on the rules page before a rule is removed. Takes the rule sentence.
strings.en: Remove this rule? {rule}. Documents stay as they are.
strings.de: Diese Regel entfernen? {rule}. Dokumente bleiben unverändert.

strings.context: Error line on the rules page when the index could not be read or changed. Takes the technical detail, which stays in English.
strings.en: The rules could not be read or changed: {detail}
strings.de: Die Regeln konnten nicht gelesen oder geändert werden: {detail}

strings.context: Placeholder of the search field in the header of the tags page; the table shows the tags that match.
Note under the switch on the tags page that turns the tags after the file names on or off.
strings.en: At most 3 per file, then “+1”. Applies to both file lists.
strings.de: Höchstens 3 pro Datei, dann „+1“. Gilt für beide Dateilisten.

strings.context: Link behind a long group of tags on the tags page that unfolds the rest of the group. {count} is the number of tags that are not shown yet.
Entry of the menu on a row of an own tag on the tags page: renames the tag everywhere it is set.
Title of the dialog on the tags page in which an own tag gets a new name everywhere it is set.
Question on the tags page before an own tag is removed from all documents. {tag} is the tag.
strings.en: Remove the tag ‘{tag}’ from all documents? The documents stay as they are.
strings.de: Das Schlagwort ‚{tag}‘ von allen Dokumenten entfernen? Die Dokumente bleiben unverändert.

strings.context: Button on the tags page that answers the remove question with yes: removes the own tag. Also the title of that dialog.
Error on the tags page: an own tag cannot be deleted because rules ask for it. {tag} is the tag, {rules} the names of the rules.
strings.en: ‘{tag}’ is a condition of these rules and stays: {rules}. Change the rules first.
strings.de: ‚{tag}‘ ist Bedingung dieser Regeln und bleibt deshalb: {rules}. Ändere zuerst die Regeln.

strings.context: Error on the tags page when the work on the index failed. {detail} is the technical reason and stays English.
strings.en: The tags could not be changed: {detail}
strings.de: Die Schlagworte ließen sich nicht ändern: {detail}

strings.context: Sentence in the middle of the tags page while the tags are read from the index.
Sentence in the middle of the tags page when the index has no tags yet.
strings.en: There are no tags yet. They appear once Hermes has read the first documents.
strings.de: Es gibt noch keine Schlagworte. Sie entstehen, sobald Hermes die ersten Dokumente gelesen hat.

strings.context: Sentence in the table of the tags page when the search finds no tag.
Right figure of a switched-off rule in the rules list, where the hits stand otherwise.
Title of the rules page while the form for a new rule is open.
Title of the rules page while the form of a suggested rule is open, before it is confirmed.
Button of the rule form: stores the rule.
Button of the rule form: closes the form and drops the changes.
Heading of the section below the rule form that lists the documents the rule would match, as a live try. One or two words.
One sentence under the heading of the try section in the rule form: what the list shows and that the try changes nothing.
strings.en: Documents this rule would match. Nothing is filed or moved.
strings.de: Dokumente, auf die diese Regel zutreffen würde. Es wird nichts abgelegt oder verschoben.

strings.context: Line in the try section of the rule form while the documents are being looked through.
Line in the try section of the rule form when no document matches the rule.
Error line in the try section of the rule form when the try could not run. Takes the technical detail, which stays English.
Last line of the try section when more documents match than are listed. Takes the number of the others.
Error line in the rule form when the user tried to save a rule without any condition, which would match every document.
strings.en: Add at least one condition, or the rule would match every document.
strings.de: Füge mindestens eine Bedingung hinzu, sonst würde die Regel auf jedes Dokument passen.

strings.context: Former entry of the command list for the key action search_documents. The action is no longer offered; a key bound to it still opens the Search view.

Theme name of the key action search_documents, shown dimmed after its plain name in the command list, and matched when typing. An allusion to bureaucracy, not a quotation; the plain name beside it says what the action does.
Label of the row of years whose documents can be chosen to narrow the hits on the Search view.
Label of the row of senders that can be chosen to narrow the hits on the Search view.
Label of the row of document kinds (invoice, contract ...) that can be chosen to narrow the hits on the Search view.
Label of the row of tags that can be chosen to narrow the hits on the Search view; several can be chosen and a hit must carry all of them.
Last row of the Quick Open list when documents are searched too: opens the Search view with the text typed in Quick Open.

Link in the summary line of the Search view while filters of read documents apply. Opens the Reports page with a new report asking what the search asks now: the words, the folder and the chosen values. Nothing is saved until the user saves it there.
Name of the year in the filing target.
Name of the month in the filing target.
Name of the day of the month; only shown for patterns an older version stored.
Name of the date in a file name.
Name of the sender in the filing target.
Name of the recipient in the filing target.
Name of the document number in a file name.
Name of the document kind in the filing target.
Before the file name of its own, after the folders: "Firma A / Year · File name: Date_Sender".
Recipient of the example document the filing target is shown with.
Kind of the example document the filing target is shown with.
Placeholder of the field in which the text of a piece of the file name is typed.
Kind of a condition: the document has a tag that starts with the value.
Kind of a condition: the kind of the document (invoice, bank statement, …) is the value.
Kind of a condition: the document comes from this source. Not offered for new conditions; it names the kind of a stored one.
Condition in a rule sentence on the rules page: the document is of a kind. Takes the kind as a word. Reads after “If” or after “and” / “or”.
Condition in a rule sentence on the rules page: the document is not of a kind. Takes the kind as a word. Reads after “If” or after “and” / “or”.
strings.de: das Dokument die Art „{value}“ nicht hat

strings.context: Condition in a rule sentence on the rules page: the document has a tag. Takes the value. Reads after “If” or after “and” / “or”.
Condition in a rule sentence on the rules page: the document has no tag with this value. Takes the value. Reads after “If” or after “and” / “or”.
strings.en: the document does not have the tag “{value}”
strings.de: das Dokument das Schlagwort „{value}“ nicht hat

strings.context: Heading above the conditions in the rule form.
Choice at a tag condition in the rule form: the document has it.
Choice at a condition in the rule form: the document does not have it, which excludes.
Help text under the conditions of the rule form. Names the kinds of the first dropdown as the user sees them.
strings.en: “firma-a” also matches firma-a-gmbh. The first field offers: Tag, Word in the text, Sender address, Account (IBAN), Tax number, Folder. “has not” excludes.
strings.de: „firma-a“ passt auch auf firma-a-gmbh. Auswahl im ersten Feld: Schlagwort, Wort im Text, Absenderadresse, Konto (IBAN), Steuernummer, Ordner. „hat nicht“ schließt aus.

strings.context: Joins two conditions of a rule sentence when the second is a tag the document must not have: a and not b.
Joins two conditions of a rule sentence when the second is a tag the document must not have: a or not b.
Label of the optional name field of the rule form.
Label of the tags a rule sets on matching documents.
Dim note next to the label Set tags: the field may stay empty.
Placeholder of the field that adds a tag in the rule form.
Label of the row of recipients that can be chosen to narrow the hits on the Search view.
Total of the amounts of the documents found, appended to the summary line of the Search view. {amount} is the sum with its currency.
Dim note on the Search view while values are chosen: they all apply at once. {values} lists the chosen values joined by the word for and.
The word between the chosen values in the note that filters apply together on the Search view.
Label of the on/off switch for the tags in the file lists on the settings tab.
Checkbox for the kind of document as a tag shown in the file lists, with examples.
Checkbox for the recipient as a tag shown in the file lists, with an example.
Checkbox for the sender as a tag shown in the file lists, with an example.
Checkbox for the year as a tag shown in the file lists, with an example.
Checkbox for the tags the user set themselves, shown in the file lists.
Main button in the bar under the status page. Reads the files with errors that are checked again, or the selected one.
Button in the add row under the list of read errors, shown from two errors on: reads every file of the list again, without asking. Same verb as the button of a single row.
At the right of a row on the read errors page: the file could not be read less than a minute ago.
At the right of a row on the read errors page: how long ago the file could not be read. {count} is a whole number of minutes, 1 to 59.
At the right of a row on the read errors page: how long ago the file could not be read. {count} is a whole number of hours, 1 or more.
Link under the selected error on the status page. Shows the file with the error in the file list.
Label in front of the two buttons under the summary line of the Search view that open the hits as a list in a panel.
Behind the first matching line of a hit in the Search view: how many more lines of the same file match. {count} is that number.
Button under the summary line of the Search view: opens the hits as a list in the left panel. The arrow points to that panel.
Button under the summary line of the Search view: opens the hits as a list in the right panel. The arrow points to that panel.
Entry of the command palette that runs the key action open_hits_left: shows the hits of the open search as a list in the left panel.
Entry of the command palette that runs the key action open_hits_right: shows the hits of the open search as a list in the right panel.
Tab title of a panel that shows the hits of a search as a list. {query} is the text that was searched for.

Line at the place of the folder path above the status bar while a panel shows search hits. {query} is the search text, {scope} the folder searched (with ~ for home), {files} and {folders} the counted parts of the list with their noun, for example '3 files' and '1 folder'.
Hint at the right end of the line that names a search-hit list: what the Esc key does there.

Notice in the status bar when the rename key is pressed with several hits tagged in a search result list. The hits live in different folders, so they cannot be renamed together; the text says what to do instead.
strings.en: Hits from different folders cannot be renamed together. Open their folder first.
strings.de: Treffer aus verschiedenen Ordnern lassen sich nicht zusammen umbenennen. Öffne zuerst ihren Ordner.

strings.context: Error in the status bar when files are copied, moved or dropped onto a panel that shows search hits as a list instead of a folder.
strings.en: The search result is a list, not a folder. Open a folder on that side first.
strings.de: Das Suchergebnis ist eine Liste, kein Ordner. Öffne dort zuerst einen Ordner.

strings.context: Error in the status bar when copying or moving files that share a name from different folders would need numbered names, but the target is inside an archive or on a server. {count} is the number of files.
strings.en: {count} files share a name. They can only be numbered into a folder on this computer.
strings.de: {count} Dateien heißen gleich. Durchnummerieren geht nur in einen Ordner auf diesem Computer.

strings.context: Entry of the context menu on a search hit: opens the folder of the file in the other panel with the cursor on it.
Entry of the context menu on a search hit: takes the tagged rows, or the cursor row, out of the list. The files stay where they are.
Line beside the title of the pack dialog when the files come from a search-hit list. {count} is the number of files.
Checkbox in the pack dialog for files from a search-hit list: keeps the folder structure in the archive.
Note beside the Keep folders checkbox: what happens when it is off.
Hint in the move dialog: files that share a name get numbers in the target folder. {count} is the number of files.
strings.en: {count} files share a name. They are numbered in the target folder:
strings.de: {count} Dateien heißen gleich. Im Zielordner werden sie durchnummeriert:

strings.context: Hint in the copy and move dialog above a list of files that get a number because several files share a name. {count} is the number of files that share a name.
strings.en: {count} files share a name. They are numbered in the target folder:
strings.de: {count} Dateien heißen gleich. Im Zielordner werden sie durchnummeriert:

strings.context: Dim note after a numbered file name in the hint about equal names: the folder the file comes from. {folder} is a path.
Hermes chat (F2): Heading of the Hermes chat window. Hermes is the name of the automatic document filing helper; keep the name.
Hermes chat (F2): Line under the heading of the Hermes chat window. Beta says the feature is new and may change.
strings.en: recognises the order of your folders · Beta
strings.de: erkennt die Ordnung deiner Ordner · Beta

strings.context: Hermes chat (F2): Hint at the right of the chat heading: the Escape key closes the chat.
Hermes chat (F2): Small button in the chat heading, left of the Esc hint. It clears the conversation and starts again with the greeting; settings, index and rules stay. Two words at most.
Hermes chat (F2): Button at the top of the chat list at the left. It starts a new chat and keeps the old ones. A plus sign and two words; the key of the button is shown beside it.
Hermes chat (F2): The key that starts a new chat, shown on the button of the chat list. {mod} is the modifier key of the system (Cmd on a Mac, Ctrl elsewhere); keep the placeholder.
Hermes chat (F2): Grey hint inside the search field above the chat list. The search looks in the titles and in the messages of all chats.
Hermes chat (F2): Heading of the group of chats used today, in the chat list. Short, capital letters.
Hermes chat (F2): Heading of the group of chats used yesterday, in the chat list. Short, capital letters.
Hermes chat (F2): Heading of the group of chats used before yesterday, in the chat list. Short, capital letters.
Hermes chat (F2): Note in the chat list when there is no chat yet.
Hermes chat (F2): Note in the chat list when the search finds no chat.
Hermes chat (F2): Status of a chat in the list, first part of the second line: Hermes made a plan that the user has not accepted or dropped yet.
Hermes chat (F2): Status of a chat in the list, first part of the second line: the work of the chat is finished.
Hermes chat (F2): Status of a chat in the list, first part of the second line: Hermes asked something and waits for the answer.
Hermes chat (F2): Status of a chat in the list, first part of the second line: the chat set up filing that goes on all the time for a folder.
Hermes chat (F2): Second line of a chat in the list. {status} is the status of the chat, {when} the time of day (today) or the date; the dot between them stays.
Hermes chat (F2): Footer of the chat list while chats are marked with the space key. {count} is how many.
Hermes chat (F2): Button in the footer of the chat list that deletes the marked chats. A verb.
Hermes chat (F2): Entry of the menu of a chat in the list: change the title of the chat. A verb.
Hermes chat (F2): Entry of the menu of a chat in the list: delete the chat. A verb.
Hermes chat (F2): Entry of the menu of a chat in the list: delete every chat whose status is done.
Hermes chat (F2): Question in the footer of the chat list before a chat is deleted that still files documents all the time. {title} is the title of the chat.
Hermes chat (F2): Question in the footer of the chat list before chats are deleted of which some still file documents all the time. {count} is how many chats run.
strings.en: {count} of them keep filing. Delete them anyway?
strings.de: {count} davon sortieren laufend ein. Trotzdem löschen?

strings.context: Hermes chat (F2): Button that answers the question about deleting a running chat with no; the chat stays.
Hermes chat (F2): Hint in the bottom bar below the chat. {mod} is the modifier key of the system (Cmd on a Mac, Ctrl elsewhere); keep the placeholder and the arrows.
strings.en: {mod}N new chat · {mod}↑/{mod}↓ switch chat · chats stay after a restart
strings.de: {mod}N neuer Chat · {mod}↑/{mod}↓ Chat wechseln · Chats bleiben nach Neustart

strings.context: Hermes chat (F2): Hint in the bottom bar below the chat while the message field is empty: how to mark and delete chats in the list.
strings.en: Space marks a chat · Del deletes

strings.context: Hermes chat (F2): Grey hint inside the empty message field of the chat. The quoted example is a sentence the user can type.
strings.en: Write to Hermes, e.g. “look at my folder Bank”
strings.de: Schreib Hermes, z. B. „sieh dir meinen Ordner Bank an“

strings.context: Hermes chat (F2): Grey hint inside the empty message field while Hermes waits for an answer to a question.
Hermes chat (F2): Tooltip of the round send button next to the message field of the chat. A verb.
Hermes chat (F2): Name of the user's Documents folder as shown in the chat (chip label and in sentences).
Hermes chat (F2): Name of the user's Downloads folder as shown in the chat (chip label and in sentences).
Hermes chat (F2): Name of the user's Desktop folder as shown in the chat (chip label and in sentences).
Hermes chat (F2): Temporary line while Hermes reads a folder. {folder} is the folder name.
Hermes chat (F2): Temporary line while Hermes undoes its last run.
Hermes chat (F2): Hermes says this when it is switched off or stopped, so it cannot read or file anything. A button to switch it on follows.
strings.en: I'm switched off right now. Shall I start?
strings.de: Ich bin gerade ausgeschaltet. Soll ich starten?

strings.context: Hermes chat (F2): Button in the chat that switches Hermes on.
Hermes chat (F2): Hermes says this when it tried to start and could not, instead of the sentence that it is switched off. {reason} is the error text of the start. A button to try again follows.
Hermes chat (F2): Hermes says this when switching it on failed because the setting could not be saved. {reason} is the error text of the write. A button to try again follows.
strings.en: I could not switch Hermes on: {reason}

strings.context: Hermes chat (F2): working line while the user's message or button press waits for the filing module to finish starting. It runs as soon as Hermes is ready.
Hermes chat (F2): Hermes says this when work was asked for but the filing module is not available (any more). Buttons follow.
strings.en: Hermes isn't ready yet. Try again in a moment.
strings.de: Hermes ist noch nicht bereit. Versuch es gleich noch einmal.

strings.context: Hermes chat (F2): working line while Hermes walks through a folder and counts the files. {folder} is the folder name, {found} the number of files found so far. Animated dots follow.
strings.de: Ich sehe mir {folder} an … {found} Dateien gefunden

strings.context: Hermes chat (F2): working line while Hermes reads the files of a folder. {folder} is the folder name, {done} the files read so far, {total} all files. Animated dots follow.
Hermes chat (F2): Hermes says this when a folder it should read does not exist (deleted, or its drive was ejected). {path} is the folder path. Buttons follow.
strings.en: {path} isn't reachable right now. Is the drive still connected?
strings.de: {path} ist gerade nicht erreichbar. Ist das Laufwerk noch da?

strings.context: Hermes chat (F2): Hermes' first message when the chat opens. Buttons with the targets and one to choose a folder follow.
strings.en: Hi! I'm Hermes: I look at a folder with you, recognise the order in it and suggest rules for it.
strings.de: Hallo! Ich bin Hermes: Ich sehe mir mit dir einen Ordner an, erkenne seine Ordnung und schlage Regeln dafür vor.

strings.context: Hermes chat (F2): Button under the greeting that opens the system folder picker; Hermes looks at the chosen folder. The ellipsis says a dialog follows.
Hermes chat (F2): Hermes' sentence after the user accepted the order of a folder. One button that opens the rule suggestions follows. {folder} is the name of the folder.
strings.en: Good. I can suggest rules for {folder} now.
strings.de: Gut. Für {folder} kann ich dir jetzt Regeln vorschlagen.

strings.context: Hermes chat (F2): Button that opens the dialog with rule suggestions for the folder. The ellipsis says a dialog follows.
Hermes chat (F2): Hermes' sentence after the dialog with rule suggestions was opened. The button of that dialog is sorting.take_rules.
strings.en: The suggestions are in the dialog; nothing is saved until you take them there.
strings.de: Die Vorschläge stehen im Dialog; gespeichert wird erst, wenn du sie dort übernimmst.

strings.context: Hermes chat (F2): Hermes' answer to a sentence that asks it to file, tidy up or move files, or to make a rule. 'File…' is the entry of the context menu of a folder. Two buttons that open the dialogs follow.
strings.en: You start filing at the folder: right-click › File…
strings.de: Einsortieren startest du am Ordner: Rechtsklick › Einsortieren…

strings.context: Hermes chat (F2): Button that opens the dialog that files a folder. The ellipsis says a dialog follows.
Hermes chat (F2): Button that opens the form for a new rule. The ellipsis says a dialog follows.
Hermes chat (F2): Button in the chat that opens the system folder picker.
Hermes chat (F2): The user typed or picked a folder that is not one of the known filing folders; Hermes asks before reading it. {name} is the name of the folder; its path follows in small type below.
strings.en: “{name}” isn't a folder I know. Read it anyway?
strings.de: „{name}“ ist kein Ordner, den ich kenne. Trotzdem lesen?

strings.context: Hermes chat (F2): Hermes found the folder the user typed and asks whether it is the right one. {name} is the name of the folder; its path follows in small type below.
Hermes chat (F2): Hermes asks which folder the user means when the name they said fits several existing folders. The full paths follow as buttons. {name} is the name as the user said it.
strings.en: Which folder do you mean by “{name}”?

strings.context: Hermes chat (F2): Button answering the question about an unknown folder: read it anyway.
Hermes chat (F2): Button in the chat that drops the current plan or question. Nothing is changed.
Hermes chat (F2): The user typed an answer, and Hermes asks them to confirm the option it understood by tapping it. {choice} is the label of that option.

Hermes chat (F2): A folder the user typed, picked or named does not exist or is not a folder. {name} is the name of the folder as the user gave it. Buttons to pick another folder or to try again follow.
strings.en: I can't find the folder “{name}”. Maybe the drive isn't connected.
strings.de: Den Ordner „{name}“ finde ich nicht. Vielleicht ist der Datenträger nicht angeschlossen.

strings.context: Hermes chat (F2): Hermes' report after reading a folder that has several areas (top-level folders with their own order). {count} is the number of files, {areas} the number of areas, for example '3 areas'. A list of areas follows.
strings.en: Done reading: {count} files in {areas} areas. This is the order I see:
strings.de: Hab ich gelesen: {count} Dateien in {areas} Bereichen. Die Ordnung sieht so aus:

strings.context: Hermes chat (F2): Hermes' report after reading a folder that has exactly one area (a top-level folder with its own order). {count} is the number of files.
strings.en: Done reading: {count} files in one area. This is the order I see:
strings.de: Hab ich gelesen: {count} Dateien in einem Bereich. Die Ordnung sieht so aus:

strings.context: Hermes chat (F2): Hermes says this when reading a folder failed. {reason} is the system's error text.
Hermes chat (F2): Hermes says this when a folder holds too many files to read. {folder} is the folder name, {limit} the largest number of files it reads.
strings.en: {folder} is too big for me: more than {limit} files. Pick a subfolder.
strings.de: {folder} ist mir zu groß: mehr als {limit} Dateien. Nimm einen Unterordner.

strings.context: Hermes chat (F2): Describes an area whose files lie directly in it, with no subfolders, in the list of areas.
Hermes chat (F2): Singular, lower case: what a folder level of an area stands for ('year'), used in the description of an area such as 'by year, then sender'.
Hermes chat (F2): Singular, lower case: what a folder level of an area stands for ('month'), used in the description of an area such as 'by year, then sender'.
Hermes chat (F2): Singular, lower case: what a folder level of an area stands for ('date'), used in the description of an area such as 'by year, then sender'.
Hermes chat (F2): Singular, lower case: what a folder level of an area stands for ('number'), used in the description of an area such as 'by year, then sender'.
Hermes chat (F2): Singular, lower case: what a folder level of an area stands for ('sender'), used in the description of an area such as 'by year, then sender'.
Hermes chat (F2): Singular, lower case: what a folder level of an area stands for ('kind'), used in the description of an area such as 'by year, then sender'.
Hermes chat (F2): Singular, lower case: what a folder level of an area stands for ('bank'), used in the description of an area such as 'by year, then sender'.
Hermes chat (F2): Singular, lower case: what a folder level of an area stands for ('insurer'), used in the description of an area such as 'by year, then sender'.
Hermes chat (F2): Singular, lower case: what a folder level of an area stands for ('vehicle'), used in the description of an area such as 'by year, then sender'.
Hermes chat (F2): Singular, lower case: what a folder level of an area stands for ('child'), used in the description of an area such as 'by year, then sender'.
Hermes chat (F2): Singular, lower case: what a folder level of an area stands for ('property'), used in the description of an area such as 'by year, then sender'.
Hermes chat (F2): Singular, lower case: what a folder level of an area stands for ('subfolder'), used in the description of an area such as 'by year, then sender'.

Hermes chat (F2): Row under the areas of a folder when more areas exist than are listed: how many more areas there are and the names of the next few, cut off by the dots. The number of files in them is added after the row. {names} is a comma separated list, {count} a number.
Hermes chat (F2): Dim row under the list of areas: folders without a recognisable order. {names} is a comma separated list of folder names.
Hermes chat (F2): Answer button under the list of areas: show every area, not only the first ones. {areas} is the number of areas.
Hermes chat (F2): Answer button: the user does not want to answer now.
Hermes chat (F2): Hermes' reply to 'Later'.
strings.en: Fine. Write to me when you need something.
strings.de: Gut. Schreib mir, wenn du etwas brauchst.

strings.context: Hermes chat (F2): Hermes asks which folder to read to learn its order. Folder buttons follow.
Hermes chat (F2): Hermes confirms that the plan was dropped and nothing was changed.
strings.en: Fine, I'll leave everything as it is.
strings.de: Gut, ich lasse alles, wie es ist.

strings.context: Hermes chat (F2): Name of a run in the undo history for files Hermes filed by itself, without being asked in the chat. {folder} is the name of the folder the files went into.
Hermes chat (F2): Name of a filing run in the undo history. {folder} is the source folder name.
Hermes (filing continuously): Name of the run in the undo history that Hermes made by itself for new files of a source. {folder} is the source name.
Hermes chat (F2): Name of a trash run in the undo history. {folder} is the folder name.
Hermes chat (F2): Hermes says there is no run to undo.
strings.en: There's no run I can undo.
strings.de: Es gibt keinen Lauf, den ich rückgängig machen kann.

strings.context: Hermes chat (F2): Hermes asks to confirm the undo of a run that moved files. **Double asterisks** mark bold text and must stay around the same words. {name} is the run name, {count} the number of files, {when} the time, {folder} the folder the files return to.
strings.en: The last run “{name}” filed **{count} files** ({when}). All {count} go back to {folder}.
strings.de: Der letzte Lauf „{name}“ hat **{count} Dateien** abgelegt ({when}). Alle {count} gehen zurück nach {folder}.

strings.context: Hermes chat (F2): Hermes asks to confirm the undo of a run that copied files. **Double asterisks** mark bold text and must stay around the same words. {name} is the run name, {count} the number of files, {when} the time.
strings.en: The last run “{name}” copied **{count} files** ({when}). I'll take the copies out again; the originals stay.
strings.de: Der letzte Lauf „{name}“ hat **{count} Dateien** kopiert ({when}). Ich nehme die Kopien wieder heraus, die Originale bleiben.

strings.context: Hermes chat (F2): Hermes asks to confirm the undo of a run that moved files to the trash. **Double asterisks** mark bold text and must stay around the same words. {name} is the run name, {count} the number of files, {when} the time.
strings.en: The last run “{name}” put **{count} files** in the trash ({when}). All {count} come back.
strings.de: Der letzte Lauf „{name}“ hat **{count} Dateien** in den Papierkorb gelegt ({when}). Alle {count} kommen zurück.

strings.context: Hermes chat (F2): Primary answer button to the undo question.
Hermes chat (F2): Time of a run when it was today. {time} is a clock time.
Hermes chat (F2): Time of a run when it was before today. {date} is a date, {time} a clock time.
Hermes chat (F2): Hermes reports a finished undo. **Double asterisks** mark bold text and must stay around the same words. {count} is the number of files.
Hermes chat (F2): Added to the undo report when some files stayed. {left} is a number.
strings.en: I left {left} because they changed or their old place is taken.
strings.de: {left} habe ich gelassen, weil sie sich geändert haben oder ihr alter Platz belegt ist.

strings.context: Hermes chat (F2): Hermes says it cannot search inside the chat yet and offers to open the search.
strings.en: I can't search in the chat yet. I'm happy to open the search for you.
strings.de: Im Chat suchen kann ich noch nicht. Die Suche öffne ich dir gern.

strings.context: Hermes chat (F2): Button in the chat that opens the document search.
Hermes chat (F2): Hermes says it cannot explain yet why a file is where it is. Buttons with things it can do follow.
strings.en: I can't explain yet why something is where it is. What would you like to do?
strings.de: Erklären, warum etwas wo liegt, kann ich noch nicht. Was hast du vor?

strings.context: Hermes chat (F2): Hermes says it did not understand the text. Buttons with things it can do follow.
strings.en: I did not get that. What would you like to do?
strings.de: Das habe ich nicht verstanden. Was möchtest du tun?

strings.context: Hermes chat (F2): Button offering the search when Hermes did not understand.
Hermes chat (F2): Button offering to tidy up a folder when Hermes did not understand.
Hermes chat (F2): Button offering to read the order of the archive when Hermes did not understand.
Hermes chat (F2): Button offering to undo the last run when Hermes did not understand.

Hermes chat (F2): Hermes explains it needs its local language model to understand typed sentences and offers to download it. {size} is the download size, for example '2741 MB'. A button to download follows.
strings.en: To understand sentences I need my language model ({size}, one time, stays on this computer). Shall I download it?
strings.de: Um Sätze zu verstehen, brauche ich mein Sprachmodell ({size}, einmalig, bleibt auf diesem Rechner). Soll ich es laden?

strings.context: Hermes chat (F2): Primary button that starts the download of the language model.
Hermes chat (F2): Hermes says the Hermes switch of the Hermes page in the settings is off, so it cannot understand typed sentences, and offers to switch it on. A button to switch it on follows.
strings.en: My AI is switched off, so I can't understand sentences. Shall I switch it on?
strings.de: Meine KI ist ausgeschaltet, so verstehe ich keine Sätze. Soll ich sie einschalten?

strings.context: Hermes chat (F2): Hermes says its language model finished downloading and can be used now. Shown before it answers the sentence that waited for the model, or before the first question.

Hermes chat (F2): An entry in the list of folders without a fixed order. It stands for the files that lie directly in the folder Hermes read, not in a subfolder. {folder} is the name of that folder as the chat shows it, for example 'Downloads'.
Hermes chat (F2): Primary button that switches the AI setting on.
Hermes chat (F2): Hermes says its language model could not be loaded or run. Buttons with things it can do follow.
strings.en: My language model could not be loaded. What would you like to do?
strings.de: Mein Sprachmodell konnte nicht geladen werden. Was möchtest du tun?

strings.context: Hermes chat (F2): Hermes says the typed text was too long for the language model. The conversation about it is forgotten, so the next sentence works again.
strings.en: That was too long for me, so I forgot it. Please say it again, shorter.
strings.de: Das war zu lang für mich, darum habe ich es vergessen. Sag es bitte noch einmal, kürzer.

strings.context: Hermes chat (F2): Hermes says the answer of the language model could not be used.
strings.en: I could not use the answer of my language model. Please try again, maybe in other words.
strings.de: Die Antwort meines Sprachmodells war nicht brauchbar. Versuche es bitte noch einmal, vielleicht mit anderen Worten.

strings.context: Hermes chat (F2): Hermes says the AI server does not answer or did not accept the request (wrong key, wrong model, no connection).
strings.en: The AI server does not answer or did not accept the request. Please check the connection and the AI settings.
strings.de: Der KI-Server antwortet nicht oder hat die Anfrage nicht angenommen. Prüfe bitte die Verbindung und die KI-Einstellungen.

strings.context: Hermes chat (F2): Hermes says nothing was sent because the user has not agreed to send texts to the AI server yet.
strings.en: Nothing was sent: you have not agreed to send this kind of data to this AI server yet. You can do that in the AI settings.
strings.de: Es wurde nichts gesendet: Du hast dem Senden dieser Art von Daten an diesen KI-Server noch nicht zugestimmt. Das geht in den KI-Einstellungen.

strings.context: Hermes chat (F2): Hermes says something broke inside the app while the language model was asked; the model itself is not to blame.
strings.en: Something went wrong inside the app. Please try again.
strings.de: In der App ist etwas schiefgegangen. Versuche es bitte noch einmal.

strings.context: Hermes chat (F2): Line shown while the language model works on a typed sentence.
Hermes chat (F2): Line shown while the language model is loaded into memory before it can work on a typed sentence; this takes a few seconds.
Hermes chat (F2): Primary button that confirms what Hermes understood. Nothing is moved by it; a trial run comes first.
Hermes chat (F2): Hermes answers a greeting, thanks or the question what it can do, with one line on what it does. Buttons with things it can do follow.
strings.en: I'm Hermes: I look at your folders, recognise their order and suggest rules for it. What would you like to do?
strings.de: Ich bin Hermes: Ich sehe mir deine Ordner an, erkenne ihre Ordnung und schlage Regeln dafür vor. Was möchtest du tun?

strings.context: Hermes chat (F2): the user said nothing should be changed; Hermes agrees politely. Buttons with things it can do follow.
strings.en: Alright, I'll leave everything as it is.
strings.de: In Ordnung, ich lasse alles so, wie es ist.

strings.context: Hermes chat (F2): one line under the card of the areas Hermes read in a folder, shown while the AI has not yet understood every document with a text. {done} is how many it understood, {total} how many documents have a text. The rest continues in the background.
strings.en: {done} of {total} documents understood, the rest continues in the background.
strings.de: {done} von {total} Dokumenten verstanden, der Rest läuft im Hintergrund.

strings.context: Hermes chat (F2): The number of files next to the name of an area in the list of areas. {count} is a number greater than one.
Hermes chat (F2): The number of files next to the name of an area in the list of areas when there is exactly one file.
Hermes chat (F2): The short word before the example path under an area in the list of areas, as in 'e.g. 2024/Bank/statement.pdf'.
Hermes chat (F2): Joins the names of a folder level that has several fixed choices, as in 'Account, Loan or Messages'. {list} is a comma separated list, {last} the final name.

Hermes chat (F2): Row under the areas of a folder when more areas exist than are listed and all of them are named. The number of files in them is added after the row. {names} is a comma separated list, {count} a number.
Hermes chat (F2): Answer button after a folder could not be read (read the same folder again) or after Hermes could not start (start it again).
Heading over the first run of pages in the feature list of the settings tab: look, language, keys. One word.
Heading over the second run of pages in the feature list of the settings tab: programs that open files, and servers. One word, noun, plural.
Heading over the third run of pages in the feature list of the settings tab: the Index, read errors and reports. One word, noun, plural.
Heading over the last run of pages in the feature list of the settings tab: the Hermes sorting, its rules and tags. Hermes is the name of the AI sorting module, a Beta mark follows it. Keep the name.
Entry of the feature list on the settings tab and title of its page: what ncrs knows about the user's files (text, sender, kind, date). One word, noun.

Sentence under the title of the Index page of the settings tab. The index is the database in which ncrs keeps what it read from the files. The Protection group further down says whether it is encrypted.
strings.en: What ncrs knows about your files: text, sender, kind, date. Stored on this computer; Protection below says whether it is encrypted.
strings.de: Was ncrs über deine Dateien weiß: Text, Absender, Art, Datum. Liegt auf diesem Computer; unter Schutz steht, ob er verschlüsselt ist.

strings.context: Entry of the feature list on the settings tab and title of its page: the page where Hermes files documents from sources into targets by rules. Verb as noun, one word.
Heading of the section of the Index page of the settings tab that lists the folders the index reads.
Heading of the section of the Index page of the settings tab about reading text from scans and photos (OCR).

Entry of the feature list on the settings tab and title of its page: the AI model Hermes (the module that sorts documents) uses, and the switch that turns Hermes on. German KI is short for künstliche Intelligenz. Short.
Sentence under the title of the AI page of the settings tab. Hermes is the module that sorts documents; the chat is opened with F2.
strings.en: One model for everything: sorting, chat (F2), rules, name suggestions.
strings.de: Ein Modell für alles: Sortieren, Chat (F2), Regeln, Namensvorschläge.

strings.context: Heading of the section of the AI page of the settings tab about the AI model: where it runs and how it is set up.
Label of the row of the AI page about the AI model on this computer; its state and the button to load it follow. The word model is meant to be searchable.
Label of the row of the AI page with the buttons that test the own AI server and save its address, model and key. Its status line tells what the test found.
Heading of the section of the Index page of the settings tab in which the user enters their own names, accounts and tax numbers.
Heading of the section of the Index page of the settings tab about the encryption of the index. One word, noun.
Heading of the section of the Index page of the settings tab that shows how far the index is: counts, pause, load, unreadable files. One word, noun.
Label of the row of the Index page that chooses which folders the index reads. Noun, plural.
